development.usageZh: 不可数名词，表示“发展、开发、成长”。常与 of 连用，如 the development of science。也可指“新进展、新情况”，此时可作可数名词。

examples.sentence: The development of the little plant takes time.
examples.trans: 这棵小植物的生长需要时间。

examples.sentence: The city has seen rapid development in the past five years.
examples.trans: 这座城市在过去五年里发展迅速。

examples.sentence: The development of online shopping has changed the way people buy things.
examples.trans: 网上购物的发展改变了人们购物的方式。

examples.sentence: Scientists are studying the development of language skills in young children.
examples.trans: 科学家们正在研究幼儿语言能力的发展过程。

examples.sentence: While economic development is important, we must not ignore its impact on the environment.
examples.trans: 虽然经济发展很重要，但我们不能忽视它对环境的影响。

examples.sentence: The development of artificial intelligence has raised both excitement and concern among researchers worldwide.
examples.trans: 人工智能的发展在全球研究者中既引发了兴奋，也引起了担忧。

convenient.usageZh: 形容词，表示“方便的、便利的”。常用结构：It is convenient (for sb) to do sth。注意主语通常不能是人，不能说 I am convenient。反义词为 inconvenient。

examples.sentence: The shop is near my home, so it is very convenient.
examples.trans: 这家商店离我家很近，所以很方便。

examples.sentence: It is convenient to take the bus to school from here.
examples.trans: 从这里坐公交车去学校很方便。

examples.sentence: Having a supermarket downstairs is convenient for people who live in this building.
examples.trans: 楼下有超市对住在这栋楼里的人来说很方便。

examples.sentence: The app makes it convenient for users to book tickets without waiting in line.
examples.trans: 这款应用让用户可以方便地订票，不用排队等候。

examples.sentence: Although online meetings are convenient, they can never fully replace face-to-face communication.
examples.trans: 虽然线上会议很方便，但它们永远无法完全取代面对面的交流。

examples.sentence: The convenience of digital payment is undeniable, yet it also raises concerns about privacy and security.
examples.trans: 数字支付的便利性不可否认，但它也引发了人们对隐私和安全的担忧。

purchase.usageZh: 可作动词和名词。作动词时是及物动词，直接接宾语，比 buy 更正式。作名词时常用搭配：make a purchase（购物）。

examples.sentence: My mom purchased a new bag yesterday.
examples.trans: 我妈妈昨天买了一个新包。

examples.sentence: You can purchase tickets at the front desk or online.
examples.trans: 你可以在前台或网上购票。

examples.sentence: He saved money for months before purchasing his first bicycle.
examples.trans: 他攒了好几个月的钱才买了他的第一辆自行车。

examples.sentence: Before purchasing any second-hand goods, it is wise to check their condition carefully.
examples.trans: 在购买任何二手商品之前，仔细检查其状况是明智的。

examples.sentence: The company decided to purchase new equipment rather than repair the old machines.
examples.trans: 公司决定购买新设备，而不是修理旧机器。

examples.sentence: Consumers are increasingly likely to research products thoroughly before making a purchase, especially for expensive items.
examples.trans: 消费者在购买前越来越倾向于充分研究产品，尤其是购买昂贵商品时。

application.usageZh: 可数名词。在科技语境下常缩写为 'app'，指手机应用程序。申请的意思常用搭配：an application for (a job/school)。

examples.sentence: I have a new learning application on my phone.
examples.trans: 我手机上有一个新的学习应用程序。

examples.sentence: My brother sent his application to three different high schools.
examples.trans: 我哥哥向三所不同的高中递交了申请。

examples.sentence: The application for the student exchange program must be handed in before the end of this month.
examples.trans: 学生交流项目的申请必须在本月底之前提交。

examples.sentence: Having reviewed all the applications carefully, the committee finally selected ten candidates for the interview.
examples.trans: 仔细审阅了所有申请之后，委员会最终选出了十名候选人参加面试。

examples.sentence: Unlike traditional maps, this navigation application updates traffic conditions in real time, which saves drivers a great deal of trouble.
examples.trans: 与传统地图不同，这款导航应用程序实时更新路况，为司机省去了大量麻烦。

examples.sentence: The university received an overwhelming number of applications this year, making the admission process far more competitive than anticipated.
examples.trans: 该大学今年收到了数量惊人的申请，使得录取过程的竞争远比预期的激烈。

register.usageZh: 可作及物或不及物动词，表示“注册、登记”，也可表示“意识到、流露出（情绪）”。常见搭配：register for a course（注册课程）、register on a website（在网站注册）、register a complaint（提出投诉）、register surprise（流露出惊讶）。名词形式为 registration。

examples.sentence: My mom helped me register for the summer camp online.
examples.trans: 我妈妈帮我在网上报名了夏令营。

examples.sentence: You need to register your new phone number with the school office.
examples.trans: 你需要向学校办公室登记你的新电话号码。

examples.sentence: If you want to use the library's online resources, you must register with your student ID first.
examples.trans: 如果你想使用图书馆的在线资源，必须先凭学生证注册。

examples.sentence: Having registered for the advanced physics course, she realized she would need to spend more time on mathematics.
examples.trans: 注册了高级物理课程后，她意识到自己需要在数学上花更多时间。

examples.sentence: The charity requires all volunteers to register their personal details before participating in any field activity.
examples.trans: 该慈善机构要求所有志愿者在参加任何实地活动之前登记个人信息。

examples.sentence: Although the warning signs had been present for months, the severity of the crisis did not fully register with policymakers until the data was released.
examples.trans: 尽管警示信号已经出现了数月，但直到数据公布后，政策制定者才充分意识到危机的严重性。

deliver.usageZh: 及物动词。常用结构：deliver sth to sb/somewhere。名词形式是 delivery。

examples.sentence: The postman delivers letters to our house every morning.
examples.trans: 邮递员每天早上把信送到我们家。

examples.sentence: The restaurant delivers hot meals to people who live nearby.
examples.trans: 这家餐厅为住在附近的人送热餐。

examples.sentence: The online store promised to deliver the books within three days, but they arrived a week late.
examples.trans: 这家网店承诺三天内把书送到，但书晚了一周才到。

examples.sentence: The company has hired extra drivers to deliver packages during the busy holiday season.
examples.trans: 该公司在繁忙的假日期间额外雇用了司机来递送包裹。

examples.sentence: Although the speech was written in a hurry, she managed to deliver it with remarkable confidence and clarity.
examples.trans: 尽管演讲稿是匆忙写成的，她仍然以非凡的自信和清晰度完成了演讲。

examples.sentence: The charity organization relies on a network of volunteers to deliver essential supplies to remote villages that are inaccessible by road.
examples.trans: 该慈善组织依靠志愿者网络，将基本物资运送到公路无法到达的偏远村庄。

refund.usageZh: 可作名词和动词。名词常用搭配：get a refund / ask for a refund / full refund。动词常用结构：refund (sb) sth 或 refund sth to sb，多用于正式或客服场景。

examples.sentence: I took the broken toy back to the shop and got a refund.
examples.trans: 我把坏掉的玩具拿回商店，拿到了退款。

examples.sentence: If the train is late for more than an hour, you can ask for a refund.
examples.trans: 如果火车晚点超过一小时，你可以要求退款。

examples.sentence: The airline promised to refund the full ticket price after the flight was cancelled.
examples.trans: 航班取消后，航空公司承诺退还全部票款。

examples.sentence: Having kept the receipt, she had no difficulty getting a refund for the faulty kettle.
examples.trans: 因为保留了收据，她毫不费力地为那个有问题的水壶拿到了退款。

examples.sentence: The company refused to issue a refund, claiming that the damage had been caused by improper use rather than a manufacturing defect.
examples.trans: 公司拒绝退款，声称损坏是由使用不当而非制造缺陷造成的。

examples.sentence: Under consumer protection law, customers are entitled to a full refund within fourteen days of purchase, provided the goods remain unused and in their original packaging.
examples.trans: 根据消费者保护法，顾客在购买后十四天内有权获得全额退款，前提是商品未使用且保留原包装。

insurance.usageZh: 不可数名词。常用搭配：have/buy/take out insurance (on/for sth)，如 travel insurance、health insurance、car insurance。注意不与不定冠词 a/an 连用。

examples.sentence: My dad pays for car insurance every year.
examples.trans: 我爸爸每年都交汽车保险费。

examples.sentence: You should buy travel insurance before you go on holiday.
examples.trans: 你去度假前应该购买旅行保险。

examples.sentence: The hospital asked if I had health insurance before they started the treatment.
examples.trans: 医院在开始治疗前问我是否有医疗保险。

examples.sentence: Having taken out insurance on the new equipment, the company felt more secure about the investment.
examples.trans: 为新设备投保后，公司对这笔投资感到更安心了。

examples.sentence: Although the policy was expensive, the comprehensive insurance covered not only theft but also accidental damage caused by natural disasters.
examples.trans: 尽管保费昂贵，这份综合保险不仅涵盖盗窃，还包括自然灾害造成的意外损坏。

examples.sentence: Critics argue that making flood insurance mandatory in high-risk areas would place an unfair financial burden on low-income households already struggling with rising living costs.
examples.trans: 批评者认为，在高风险地区强制推行洪水保险会给已经在应对生活成本上涨的低收入家庭带来不公平的经济负担。

reservation.usageZh: 可数名词。常用搭配：make a reservation (for sth)，如 make a dinner reservation、make a hotel reservation。动词是 reserve，如 reserve a table。

examples.sentence: We made a reservation at the pizza restaurant for six o'clock.
examples.trans: 我们在披萨店预订了六点的位子。

examples.sentence: The hotel was full, so we couldn't get a reservation for Friday night.
examples.trans: 酒店客满了，所以我们没能订到周五晚上的房间。

examples.sentence: I called the restaurant to change my reservation from two people to four.
examples.trans: 我打电话给餐厅，把预订从两人改成了四人。

examples.sentence: Having made a reservation well in advance, we were able to secure a window seat overlooking the river.
examples.trans: 由于提前很久就预订了，我们得以订到一个俯瞰河景的靠窗座位。

examples.sentence: The restaurant requires a deposit to confirm any reservation of more than eight people, which is a common practice during the holiday season.
examples.trans: 该餐厅要求超过八人的预订支付押金以确认，这在节假日期间是常见做法。

examples.sentence: Despite holding a confirmed reservation, the guests were told upon arrival that no tables were available, prompting the manager to offer a complimentary meal as compensation.
examples.trans: 尽管持有已确认的预订，客人到达时却被告知没有空桌，经理因此提供了一顿免费餐作为补偿。

appointment.usageZh: 可数名词，意为“约会；预约”。常见搭配：make an appointment（预约）、have an appointment（有约）、keep/cancel an appointment（守约/取消预约）。多用于正式或商务、医疗场合，朋友间的随意见面一般用 plan 或 meet up。

examples.sentence: I have an appointment with the doctor at three o'clock.
examples.trans: 我三点钟和医生有个预约。

examples.sentence: She called the hair salon to make an appointment for Saturday morning.
examples.trans: 她打电话给美发沙龙，预约了周六早上的时间。

examples.sentence: If you need to cancel the appointment, please let us know at least one day in advance.
examples.trans: 如果你需要取消预约，请至少提前一天通知我们。

examples.sentence: Having made an appointment with the professor, he arrived ten minutes early to prepare his questions.
examples.trans: 和教授约好之后，他提前十分钟到达，准备自己要问的问题。

examples.sentence: Unlike a casual meet-up, a formal appointment carries an expectation that both parties will arrive on time.
examples.trans: 与随意的见面不同，正式预约意味着双方都应准时到达。

examples.sentence: Patients who repeatedly fail to attend appointments without prior notice may be removed from the clinic's registration list.
examples.trans: 多次无故爽约的患者可能会被该诊所从挂号名单中移除。

accommodation.usageZh: 不可数名词（英式英语），指“住宿；膳宿”。常见搭配：arrange/find/provide accommodation（安排/找到/提供住宿）。美式英语中常用 accommodations（复数）。注意不能与动词 accommodate（容纳；为……提供住宿）混淆。

examples.sentence: We need to find cheap accommodation near the train station.
examples.trans: 我们需要在火车站附近找便宜的住宿。

examples.sentence: The travel agency arranged accommodation for us during the whole trip.
examples.trans: 旅行社为我们安排了整个旅行期间的住宿。

examples.sentence: The price of the tour includes flights, meals, and accommodation for five nights.
examples.trans: 这个旅行团的价格包含机票、餐食和五晚住宿。

examples.sentence: Students who apply for campus accommodation before the deadline are more likely to get a room in the main building.
examples.trans: 在截止日期前申请校内住宿的学生更有可能分到主楼的房间。

examples.sentence: While the hotel offers luxurious accommodation, its remote location discourages many potential guests.
examples.trans: 虽然这家酒店提供豪华住宿，但其偏远的位置让许多潜在客人望而却步。

examples.sentence: Given the severe housing shortage in the city, affordable accommodation for low-income families has become a pressing policy issue.
examples.trans: 鉴于该市严重的住房短缺问题，为低收入家庭提供可负担的住宿已成为一个紧迫的政策议题。

reliable.usageZh: 形容词，意为“可靠的；可信赖的”。可修饰人或物，如 a reliable friend（可靠的朋友）、reliable information（可靠的信息）。常见结构：be reliable、prove reliable（证明是可靠的）。名词形式为 reliability。

examples.sentence: My uncle is a reliable person; he always keeps his promises.
examples.trans: 我叔叔是个可靠的人，他总是信守承诺。

examples.sentence: We need a reliable babysitter who can come every Friday evening.
examples.trans: 我们需要一个可靠的保姆，每周五晚上都能来。

examples.sentence: The website is not a reliable source of information, so you should check other references.
examples.trans: 这个网站不是可靠的信息来源，所以你应该查阅其他参考资料。

examples.sentence: Having proved reliable over many years, the old software is still widely used in small businesses.
examples.trans: 由于多年来被证明是可靠的，这款老软件在小企业中仍被广泛使用。

examples.sentence: A reliable witness is one whose account remains consistent even under intense cross-examination.
examples.trans: 可靠的证人是指即使在严厉的交叉盘问下，其陈述仍保持一致的人。

examples.sentence: In an era of information overload, the ability to distinguish reliable data from misleading content is an essential academic skill.
examples.trans: 在信息过载的时代，区分可靠数据与误导性内容的能力是一项基本的学术技能。

benefit.usageZh: 可作名词和动词。名词常用搭配：benefit of/from sth，表示“某事物的好处”。动词常用结构：benefit from sth，表示“从某事中受益”。名词可数，常与 health、economic、long-term 等形容词连用。

examples.sentence: Eating fruit every day has a big benefit for your body.
examples.trans: 每天吃水果对身体有很大好处。

examples.sentence: One benefit of walking to school is that you can get fresh air.
examples.trans: 步行上学的一个好处是你可以呼吸到新鲜空气。

examples.sentence: If you read English every morning, you will benefit from it in the long run.
examples.trans: 如果你每天早上读英语，从长远来看你会从中受益。

examples.sentence: Students who take part in team sports benefit greatly from learning how to cooperate with others.
examples.trans: 参加团队运动的学生能从学习如何与他人合作中获益良多。

examples.sentence: Unlike short-term gains, the benefits of consistent reading extend far beyond exam scores.
examples.trans: 与短期收益不同，持续阅读的好处远远超出考试分数。

examples.sentence: The new policy is designed to benefit not only large corporations but also small businesses struggling to survive.
examples.trans: 这项新政策旨在不仅使大公司受益，也使苦苦挣扎的小企业受益。

arrange.usageZh: 动词。常用结构：arrange sth (for sb)，表示为某人安排某事；arrange to do sth，表示安排做某事；arrange for sb to do sth，表示安排某人做某事。名词形式为 arrangement，常与 make、come to 等动词搭配。

examples.sentence: My mom arranged the flowers in a beautiful vase.
examples.trans: 我妈妈把花插在一个漂亮的花瓶里。

examples.sentence: We need to arrange a time to practice the play together.
examples.trans: 我们需要安排一个时间一起排练这个话剧。

examples.sentence: The teacher arranged for a famous writer to visit our school next Friday.
examples.trans: 老师安排了一位著名作家下周五来我们学校。

examples.sentence: Having arranged all the details in advance, she felt confident about the presentation.
examples.trans: 提前安排好所有细节后，她对这次展示充满信心。

examples.sentence: The travel agency arranged everything so efficiently that we didn't have to worry about a single thing.
examples.trans: 旅行社安排得如此高效，以至于我们什么都不用担心。

examples.sentence: Before the summit, diplomats spent weeks arranging the seating plan to avoid any potential conflicts between the two delegations.
examples.trans: 峰会前，外交官们花了数周时间安排座位方案，以避免两个代表团之间可能出现的冲突。

official.usageZh: 形容词和名词。作形容词时常用在名词前，如 official website、official statement，表示“官方的、正式的”。作名词时指“官员”，可数。口语中也可表示“非正式的官方说法”。

examples.sentence: The school's official uniform is blue and white.
examples.trans: 学校的官方校服是蓝白相间的。

examples.sentence: You can find the official rules on the school notice board.
examples.trans: 你可以在学校公告栏上找到官方规则。

examples.sentence: The mayor made an official visit to our town last month.
examples.trans: 市长上个月对我们镇进行了一次正式访问。

examples.sentence: According to an official report released yesterday, air quality in the city has improved significantly.
examples.trans: 根据昨天发布的一份官方报告，该市的空气质量已显著改善。

examples.sentence: Although the rumor spread quickly online, no official confirmation has been given by the government.
examples.trans: 尽管谣言在网上迅速传播，但政府尚未给出任何官方确认。

examples.sentence: The official responsible for overseeing the project refused to comment on the budget cuts until the investigation was complete.
examples.trans: 负责监督该项目的官员在调查完成之前拒绝就预算削减发表评论。

avoid.usageZh: 及物动词，后面接名词或动名词（avoid doing sth），不能接不定式。常用于表示“避免做某事”或“避开某人/某物”。口语和书面语都常用。

examples.sentence: I avoid the big dog on my way to school.
examples.trans: 我上学路上避开那只大狗。

examples.sentence: You should avoid eating too much sugar before bed.
examples.trans: 你应该避免睡前吃太多糖。

examples.sentence: He took a different road to avoid the heavy traffic.
examples.trans: 他走了另一条路以避开拥堵的交通。

examples.sentence: To avoid making the same mistake, she checked her work twice before handing it in.
examples.trans: 为了避免犯同样的错误，她在交作业前检查了两遍。

examples.sentence: Rather than avoiding the problem, we should face it directly and find a practical solution.
examples.trans: 与其回避问题，我们不如直接面对它并找到一个切实可行的解决办法。

examples.sentence: Effective time management allows students to avoid the stress that comes from leaving tasks until the last minute.
examples.trans: 有效的时间管理能让学生避免因把任务拖到最后一刻而产生的压力。

experience.usageZh: 可作名词和动词。作名词时，表示“经验”不可数，表示“经历”可数；作动词时是及物动词，表示“经历、体验”。常见搭配：gain experience, work experience, personal experience。

examples.sentence: My first camping trip was a fun experience.
examples.trans: 我的第一次露营是一次有趣的经历。

examples.sentence: She has a lot of experience in looking after young children.
examples.trans: 她在照顾小孩方面有很多经验。

examples.sentence: The volunteer work gave him valuable experience that he couldn't learn from books.
examples.trans: 志愿工作给了他书本上学不到的宝贵经验。

examples.sentence: Having experienced failure once, he now understands the importance of careful preparation.
examples.trans: 经历过一次失败后，他现在明白了认真准备的重要性。

examples.sentence: Unlike theoretical knowledge, practical experience enables learners to respond flexibly to unexpected situations.
examples.trans: 与理论知识不同，实践经验使学习者能够灵活应对突发情况。

examples.sentence: The study suggests that students who are exposed to diverse cultural experiences tend to develop stronger critical thinking skills.
examples.trans: 研究表明，接触多元文化经历的学生往往能培养出更强的批判性思维能力。

various.usageZh: 形容词，只用在名词前作定语，表示“各种各样的、不同的”。比 many 更强调种类多样。名词形式是 variety，常见短语 a variety of。

examples.sentence: There are various fruits in the basket.
examples.trans: 篮子里有各种各样的水果。

examples.sentence: The shop sells various kinds of school bags for students.
examples.trans: 这家商店出售各种学生书包。

examples.sentence: The library offers various activities to encourage children to read more.
examples.trans: 图书馆提供各种活动来鼓励孩子们多读书。

examples.sentence: The survey collected opinions from people of various ages and backgrounds.
examples.trans: 这项调查收集了不同年龄和背景的人的意见。

examples.sentence: The course covers various aspects of environmental protection, ranging from recycling to energy saving.
examples.trans: 这门课程涵盖环境保护的多个方面，从回收到节能。

examples.sentence: Researchers have proposed various explanations for the decline in bee populations, yet no single factor has been confirmed as the primary cause.
examples.trans: 研究人员对蜜蜂数量下降提出了多种解释，但尚未确认任何单一因素是主要原因。

platform.usageZh: 可数名词。基本义为“平台”，可指车站月台、舞台等实体平台，也可指社交媒体、在线学习等抽象平台。常用搭配：social media platform（社交媒体平台），online learning platform（在线学习平台），train platform（火车月台）。

family.meaning: 把……放在平台上；为……提供平台

examples.sentence: We waited for the train on the platform.
examples.trans: 我们在月台上等火车。

examples.sentence: She stood on the platform and gave a short speech to the whole school.
examples.trans: 她站在讲台上，向全校师生做了一个简短的演讲。

examples.sentence: The library has set up an online platform where students can borrow e-books for free.
examples.trans: 图书馆建立了一个在线平台，学生可以在那里免费借阅电子书。

examples.sentence: Having gained a large following on social media, she used her platform to raise awareness about environmental issues.
examples.trans: 在社交媒体上积累了大量粉丝后，她利用自己的平台提高人们对环境问题的关注。

examples.sentence: Unlike traditional classrooms, an online learning platform allows students to review recorded lectures at their own pace.
examples.trans: 与传统课堂不同，在线学习平台允许学生按照自己的节奏复习录播课程。

examples.sentence: The newly launched digital platform, which integrates payment, transportation, and public services, has fundamentally transformed how citizens navigate urban life.
examples.trans: 这个新推出的数字平台整合了支付、交通和公共服务，从根本上改变了市民应对城市生活的方式。

occupation.usageZh: 可数名词，意为“职业，工作”，比 job 更正式。常用搭配：choose an occupation（选择职业），a full-time occupation（全职工作），primary occupation（主要职业）。也可表示“占领，占用”，如 military occupation（军事占领）。

examples.sentence: My father's occupation is a bus driver.
examples.trans: 我爸爸的职业是公交车司机。

examples.sentence: Please write your name, age, and occupation on this form.
examples.trans: 请在这张表格上填写你的姓名、年龄和职业。

examples.sentence: Choosing an occupation that matches your interests can make work feel more meaningful.
examples.trans: 选择一份与你的兴趣相匹配的职业，可以让工作变得更有意义。

examples.sentence: Having spent years training as a nurse, she found her true occupation in caring for elderly patients.
examples.trans: 经过多年护士培训后，她发现照顾老年病人才是自己真正的职业。

examples.sentence: While some people view cooking as a mere household chore, for a professional chef it is both an occupation and an art form.
examples.trans: 虽然有些人把烹饪仅仅看作家务活，但对专业厨师来说，它既是一种职业，也是一种艺术形式。

examples.sentence: The survey revealed that job satisfaction depends less on income than on whether one's occupation provides a sense of purpose and autonomy.
examples.trans: 调查显示，工作满意度与其说取决于收入，不如说取决于一个人的职业是否提供目标感和自主性。

renowned.usageZh: 形容词，意为“著名的，有声望的”，比 famous 更正式，常用于书面语。常用搭配：be renowned for（因……而闻名），a renowned expert/artist/university（著名的专家/艺术家/大学）。通常作定语或用于 be renowned for/as 结构。

examples.sentence: The city is renowned for its beautiful old bridges.
examples.trans: 这座城市以其美丽的老桥而闻名。

examples.sentence: A renowned doctor from Beijing will visit our school and give a talk about health.
examples.trans: 一位来自北京的著名医生将访问我们学校，并做一个关于健康的讲座。

examples.sentence: The small town became renowned after a famous movie was filmed there.
examples.trans: 一部著名电影在那里拍摄后，这个小镇就出名了。

examples.sentence: Renowned for her groundbreaking research in genetics, Professor Li was invited to speak at conferences around the world.
examples.trans: 李教授因其在遗传学领域的开创性研究而闻名，被邀请到世界各地的会议上发言。

examples.sentence: The restaurant is renowned not for its luxurious decoration but for the authentic flavors that have remained unchanged for three generations.
examples.trans: 这家餐厅之所以出名，不是因为豪华的装修，而是因为三代人保持不变的地道风味。

examples.sentence: A renowned economist once argued that long-term prosperity depends less on natural resources than on a nation's capacity to cultivate and retain creative talent.
examples.trans: 一位著名经济学家曾提出，长期繁荣与其说取决于自然资源，不如说取决于一个国家培养和留住创造性人才的能力。

download.usageZh: 及物动词，表示“下载”。反义词：upload（上传）。常见搭配：download a file/app（下载文件/应用）、download from the Internet（从网上下载）。口语和书面语都常用。

examples.sentence: I download songs to my phone every weekend.
examples.trans: 我每个周末都把歌曲下载到手机上。

examples.sentence: My brother taught me how to download a map before we go hiking.
examples.trans: 我哥哥教我在去远足前如何下载地图。

examples.sentence: You should download the ticket in advance so that you can show it at the gate.
examples.trans: 你应该提前下载好票，这样就能在门口出示。

examples.sentence: Having downloaded the software, she followed the instructions to set up her account.
examples.trans: 下载完软件后，她按照说明设置了自己的账户。

examples.sentence: Unlike streaming, downloading the video allows you to watch it offline without using mobile data.
examples.trans: 与在线播放不同，下载视频可以让你离线观看而不消耗移动数据。

examples.sentence: Before downloading any attachment from an unknown sender, users are advised to verify its source to avoid potential security risks.
examples.trans: 在从陌生发件人处下载任何附件之前，建议用户核实其来源，以避免潜在的安全风险。

instructor.usageZh: 可数名词，指教授某种技能或课程的“教师、指导者”。常见搭配：a driving instructor（驾驶教练）、a fitness instructor（健身教练）、a ski instructor（滑雪教练）。比 teacher 更侧重技能训练或实践指导。

examples.sentence: Our art instructor showed us how to draw a cat.
examples.trans: 我们的美术老师教我们怎么画猫。

examples.sentence: The driving instructor asked me to check the mirror before turning left.
examples.trans: 驾驶教练让我在左转前先看后视镜。

examples.sentence: The fitness instructor explained why warming up is necessary before running.
examples.trans: 健身教练解释了为什么跑步前热身是必要的。

examples.sentence: Impressed by the instructor's clear explanations, the beginners quickly gained confidence in the water.
examples.trans: 由于对教练清晰的讲解印象深刻，初学者们很快在水中建立了信心。

examples.sentence: A good instructor not only demonstrates the technique but also gives immediate feedback on each attempt.
examples.trans: 一位好的指导者不仅示范技巧，还会对每次尝试给出即时反馈。

examples.sentence: The course instructor emphasized that consistent practice, rather than natural talent alone, determines long-term progress.
examples.trans: 课程指导教师强调，长期进步取决于持续练习，而不仅仅是天赋。

negative.usageZh: 形容词，表示“消极的、负面的”。反义词：positive（积极的）。常见搭配：negative attitude（消极态度）、negative effect/impact（负面影响）、negative emotion（负面情绪）。也可用于数学或科学语境，表示“负的、阴性的”。

examples.sentence: Don't say negative things about your friends.
examples.trans: 不要说朋友的坏话。

examples.sentence: Too much screen time can have a negative effect on your eyes.
examples.trans: 看屏幕时间太长会对眼睛产生负面影响。

examples.sentence: If you always focus on the negative side, you will miss many good things around you.
examples.trans: 如果你总是关注消极的一面，你会错过身边许多美好的事物。

examples.sentence: The report revealed that constant criticism creates a negative atmosphere in the workplace.
examples.trans: 报告显示，持续的批评会在工作场所营造一种消极的氛围。

examples.sentence: While constructive feedback is helpful, purely negative comments without suggestions rarely lead to improvement.
examples.trans: 建设性的反馈是有帮助的，但纯粹负面且没有建议的评论很少能带来改进。

examples.sentence: Researchers found that prolonged exposure to negative news significantly increases anxiety levels among adolescents.
examples.trans: 研究人员发现，长期接触负面新闻会显著提高青少年的焦虑水平。

attention.usageZh: 不可数名词，表示“注意、关注”。常见搭配：pay attention to（注意）、attract/draw/gain attention（引起关注）、give attention to（给予关注）。口语和书面语都常用，正式场合可用 direct attention to。

examples.sentence: Please pay attention to the teacher in class.
examples.trans: 上课时请注意听老师讲。

examples.sentence: The little dog drew everyone's attention at the park.
examples.trans: 那只小狗在公园里吸引了所有人的注意。

examples.sentence: You should pay more attention to your spelling when you write a composition.
examples.trans: 写作文时你应该更加注意拼写。

examples.sentence: The report has drawn public attention to the problem of food waste in school canteens.
examples.trans: 这份报告引起了公众对学校食堂食物浪费问题的关注。

examples.sentence: While the lecture covered many topics, the speaker directed particular attention to the role of sleep in memory.
examples.trans: 虽然讲座涵盖了许多主题，但演讲者特别关注了睡眠在记忆中的作用。

examples.sentence: Despite repeated warnings from scientists, the issue failed to attract sustained attention from policymakers until the crisis became impossible to ignore.
examples.trans: 尽管科学家们一再发出警告，但直到危机变得无法忽视之前，这个问题始终未能引起政策制定者的持续关注。

edit.usageZh: 及物动词，表示“编辑、剪辑”。常用搭配：edit a video/document/photo（剪辑视频/编辑文档/修图）、edit out（删掉）。可用于文字、音频、视频等多种材料。

examples.sentence: My brother likes to edit photos on his phone.
examples.trans: 我哥哥喜欢在手机上修照片。

examples.sentence: We learned how to edit a short video in our computer class.
examples.trans: 我们在电脑课上学了如何剪辑短视频。

examples.sentence: Before you hand in the article, edit it carefully to remove any unnecessary words.
examples.trans: 交文章之前，仔细编辑一下，删掉不必要的词。

examples.sentence: She spent the whole afternoon editing the interview recording into a three-minute clip for the school website.
examples.trans: 她花了整个下午把采访录音剪辑成一段三分钟的短片，放到学校网站上。

examples.sentence: Unlike writing a first draft, editing demands a critical eye for structure, tone, and precision rather than sheer creativity.
examples.trans: 与写初稿不同，编辑工作要求以批判的眼光审视结构、语气和准确性，而非单纯的创造力。

examples.sentence: The documentary was heavily edited for television, with nearly forty minutes of original footage cut to fit the broadcast slot.
examples.trans: 这部纪录片为电视播出做了大量剪辑，近四十分钟的原始素材被删减以适应播出时段。

attractive.usageZh: 形容词，表示“有吸引力的、诱人的”。常用结构：be attractive to sb.（对某人有吸引力）、an attractive offer/price（有吸引力的报价/价格）、look attractive（看起来吸引人）。可用于形容人、物、条件、方案等。

examples.sentence: The red dress looks very attractive on you.
examples.trans: 那条红裙子穿在你身上很好看。

examples.sentence: The shop made an attractive window display to bring in more customers.
examples.trans: 这家商店做了一个吸引人的橱窗展示来招揽更多顾客。

examples.sentence: The company offered him an attractive salary, so he decided to take the job.
examples.trans: 公司给了他一份有吸引力的薪水，所以他决定接受这份工作。

examples.sentence: Making public transport more attractive to commuters is a key part of the city's plan to reduce traffic.
examples.trans: 让公共交通对通勤者更有吸引力，是该市减少交通拥堵计划的关键部分。

examples.sentence: The proposal is attractive in theory, but its practical costs may outweigh the promised benefits.
examples.trans: 这个方案在理论上很有吸引力，但实际成本可能超过所承诺的收益。

examples.sentence: What makes the position particularly attractive is not merely the salary but the opportunity to work alongside leading researchers in the field.
examples.trans: 使这个职位特别有吸引力的不仅是薪水，更是能与该领域顶尖研究人员共事的机会。

display.usageZh: 作及物动词时表示“展示、陈列”，宾语常为商品、作品、情绪或能力。作名词时常用短语 on display（在展出中）、put sth on display（把某物展出）。在书面语中也可表示“显示（数据、信息）”。

examples.sentence: The shop window displays many beautiful toys.
examples.trans: 商店橱窗里陈列着许多漂亮的玩具。

examples.sentence: The museum displays old coins from different countries.
examples.trans: 这家博物馆展出不同国家的古钱币。

examples.sentence: The screen displays the temperature and the time clearly.
examples.trans: 屏幕上清楚地显示着温度和时间。

examples.sentence: The students' science projects are on display in the school hall this week.
examples.trans: 学生们的科学项目本周在学校大厅展出。

examples.sentence: Unlike his brother, who hides his feelings, Tom openly displays his excitement about the trip.
examples.trans: 与隐藏情感的哥哥不同，汤姆公开表现出对这次旅行的兴奋。

examples.sentence: The data displayed on the monitor suggests that the new policy has had a measurable impact on local employment.
examples.trans: 显示器上显示的数据表明，新政策对当地就业产生了可衡量的影响。

profit.usageZh: 作名词时表示“利润、收益”，可数或不可数。常用搭配：make a profit（盈利）、net profit（净利润）、profit margin（利润率）。作动词时表示“获益”，常与 from/by 连用。

examples.sentence: The little shop makes a small profit every day.
examples.trans: 这家小店每天赚一点钱。

examples.sentence: They sold all the cakes and made a good profit.
examples.trans: 他们把蛋糕全卖光了，赚了不少钱。

examples.sentence: The company's profits rose by ten percent last year.
examples.trans: 这家公司去年的利润增长了百分之十。

examples.sentence: Many non-profit organizations rely on volunteers to carry out their daily work.
examples.trans: 许多非营利组织依靠志愿者来开展日常工作。

examples.sentence: The firm reinvested a large part of its profits in developing cleaner production methods.
examples.trans: 该公司将大部分利润再投资于开发更清洁的生产方法。

examples.sentence: While short-term profits may decline, the restructuring is expected to strengthen the company's long-term competitiveness.
examples.trans: 尽管短期利润可能下降，但这次重组有望增强公司的长期竞争力。

broadcast.usageZh: 作动词时表示“广播、播送”，过去式和过去分词均为 broadcast。常用搭配：broadcast live（现场直播）、broadcast a programme（播出一个节目）。作名词时表示“广播节目、电视节目”。

examples.sentence: The radio broadcasts music every morning.
examples.trans: 收音机每天早上播放音乐。

examples.sentence: The TV station will broadcast the school concert tonight.
examples.trans: 电视台今晚将播出学校音乐会。

examples.sentence: The news is broadcast at seven o'clock every evening.
examples.trans: 新闻每天晚上七点播出。

examples.sentence: The interview with the famous scientist will be broadcast live on national television.
examples.trans: 对这位著名科学家的采访将在国家电视台现场直播。

examples.sentence: Although the match started late at night, it was still broadcast to millions of viewers across the country.
examples.trans: 尽管比赛在深夜开始，但仍然向全国数百万观众播出。

examples.sentence: The documentary, originally broadcast in 2019, has been updated to include the latest research findings on climate change.
examples.trans: 这部纪录片最初于2019年播出，现已更新，纳入了气候变化的最新研究成果。

abundant.usageZh: 形容词，意为“丰富的，充裕的”。常用于正式或书面语。常见搭配：be abundant in（富于……），abundant rainfall（充沛的降雨），abundant evidence（充足的证据）。

examples.sentence: There is abundant fruit in the market this summer.
examples.trans: 今年夏天市场上水果很丰富。

examples.sentence: The river provides abundant water for the nearby farms.
examples.trans: 这条河为附近的农场提供了充足的水源。

examples.sentence: Because the soil is rich, the village has an abundant supply of vegetables all year round.
examples.trans: 由于土壤肥沃，这个村庄全年都有充足的蔬菜供应。

examples.sentence: Having grown up in a coastal city, she developed an abundant knowledge of marine life.
examples.trans: 由于在海滨城市长大，她对海洋生物积累了丰富的知识。

examples.sentence: Unlike the barren northern slopes, the southern valleys are abundant in wildflowers every spring.
examples.trans: 与贫瘠的北坡不同，南侧的山谷每年春天都盛开着大量的野花。

examples.sentence: The study concludes that regions with abundant access to early childhood education tend to show higher long-term social mobility.
examples.trans: 该研究得出结论：能够充分获得早期儿童教育的地区，往往表现出更高的长期社会流动性。

opportunity.usageZh: 可数名词，意为“机会，时机”。常用短语：seize/grab an opportunity（抓住机会），a golden opportunity（绝佳机会），equal opportunities（平等机会）。

examples.sentence: This summer camp is a good opportunity to make new friends.
examples.trans: 这次夏令营是结交新朋友的好机会。

examples.sentence: The school trip gave us a great opportunity to learn about history outside the classroom.
examples.trans: 这次学校旅行给了我们一个在课堂外学习历史的好机会。

examples.sentence: If you don't seize this opportunity now, you may not get another one like it.
examples.trans: 如果你现在不抓住这个机会，可能就不会再有这样的机会了。

examples.sentence: Taking a gap year offers students a valuable opportunity to gain practical experience before entering university.
examples.trans: 间隔年为学生在进入大学前获得实践经验提供了宝贵的机会。

examples.sentence: The scholarship represents not merely financial support but a rare opportunity to study under world-class researchers.
examples.trans: 这项奖学金不仅意味着经济资助，更是一个在世界级研究者指导下学习的难得机会。

examples.sentence: While digital platforms have created unprecedented opportunities for remote collaboration, they have also widened the gap between those with and without reliable internet access.
examples.trans: 虽然数字平台为远程协作创造了前所未有的机会，但也拉大了有无可靠网络接入人群之间的差距。

mislead.usageZh: 及物动词，过去式和过去分词为 misled。常用结构：mislead sb. into doing sth.（误导某人做某事），也可直接接宾语。多用于谈论信息、广告、表象等使人产生错误判断的语境。

family.meaning: 误导性的，使人产生误解的

examples.sentence: The sign on the road misled my dad, so we got lost.
examples.trans: 路上的标志误导了我爸爸，所以我们迷路了。

examples.sentence: Some pictures on food boxes can mislead you about what is inside.
examples.trans: 食品盒上的一些图片可能会让你对里面的东西产生误解。

examples.sentence: The advertisement misled many people into believing the product could make them healthier.
examples.trans: 这则广告误导了许多人，让他们相信这个产品能让他们更健康。

examples.sentence: The report was criticized for using data in a way that misled the public about the real risks.
examples.trans: 这份报告因使用数据的方式误导了公众对真实风险的认识而受到批评。

examples.sentence: While the figures appear encouraging at first glance, they mislead us into overlooking the widening gap between urban and rural areas.
examples.trans: 虽然这些数字乍一看令人鼓舞，但它们误导我们忽视了城乡之间日益扩大的差距。

examples.sentence: A seemingly neutral tone in media coverage can mislead audiences into equating unverified claims with well-established facts.
examples.trans: 媒体报道中看似中立的语气可能误导受众，使他们将未经证实的说法与确凿的事实等同起来。

blogger.usageZh: 可数名词，指定期撰写博客的人。由 blog 加后缀 -er 构成。常与 travel、food、fashion、tech 等名词搭配，表示某一领域的博主。

examples.sentence: My sister wants to be a food blogger because she loves cooking.
examples.trans: 我姐姐想成为一名美食博主，因为她喜欢做饭。

examples.sentence: The blogger wrote a post about how to save money on school supplies.
examples.trans: 这位博主写了一篇关于如何在学习用品上省钱的帖子。

examples.sentence: A local blogger recorded the changes in our neighborhood over the past ten years.
examples.trans: 一位本地博主记录了我们社区过去十年的变化。

examples.sentence: Having built a large online following, the blogger was invited to speak at a digital media conference.
examples.trans: 由于在网上积累了大量粉丝，这位博主受邀在一场数字媒体会议上发言。

examples.sentence: Unlike traditional journalists, a blogger often writes from personal experience rather than relying on formal interviews.
examples.trans: 与传统记者不同，博主通常根据个人经历写作，而不是依赖正式采访。

examples.sentence: The credibility of a blogger hinges not on institutional backing but on the consistency and transparency of their content over time.
examples.trans: 博主的可信度不取决于机构背书，而取决于其内容长期的一致性和透明度。

economy.usageZh: 可数或不可数名词，指一个国家或地区的经济体系。常用搭配：global economy（全球经济）、knowledge economy（知识经济）、boost the economy（促进经济）。也可指节约、节省，如 economy of time（节省时间）。

examples.sentence: Tourism brings a lot of money to the local economy.
examples.trans: 旅游业给当地经济带来了很多收入。

examples.sentence: Small shops are an important part of the city's economy.
examples.trans: 小商店是这座城市经济的重要组成部分。

examples.sentence: When more people have jobs, the whole economy grows stronger.
examples.trans: 当更多人有工作时，整个经济就会变得更强劲。

examples.sentence: The government introduced new policies aimed at stabilizing the economy after a period of rapid inflation.
examples.trans: 政府出台了新政策，旨在经历一段快速通胀期后稳定经济。

examples.sentence: A knowledge-based economy depends less on natural resources and more on the skills and creativity of its workforce.
examples.trans: 知识经济对自然资源的依赖较少，而更多地依赖劳动力的技能和创造力。

examples.sentence: The shift toward a circular economy, in which waste is minimized and materials are reused, is reshaping how industries measure long-term growth.
examples.trans: 向循环经济（即尽量减少浪费并重复利用材料）的转变，正在重塑各行业衡量长期增长的方式。

fragmented.usageZh: 形容词，常用于描述信息、时间、记忆或市场等被分割成零散部分的状态。常见搭配：fragmented information（碎片化信息）、fragmented time（碎片时间）、fragmented memory（零散的记忆）。多用于书面语或较正式的讨论中。

examples.sentence: My little brother's toy car broke into fragmented pieces.
examples.trans: 我弟弟的玩具车碎成了好几块。

examples.sentence: She only had fragmented memories of the trip because she was very tired.
examples.trans: 因为太累了，她对那次旅行只有零散的记忆。

examples.sentence: If you keep getting fragmented information, you may find it hard to understand the whole story.
examples.trans: 如果你一直获取碎片化的信息，可能很难理解整个事情的来龙去脉。

examples.sentence: The report presents a fragmented picture of the company's performance, making it difficult to draw a clear conclusion.
examples.trans: 这份报告呈现了公司业绩的零散情况，让人难以得出清晰的结论。

examples.sentence: Unlike a coherent narrative, a fragmented account of events often leaves readers confused rather than informed.
examples.trans: 与连贯的叙述不同，对事件的零散描述往往让读者感到困惑，而非获得信息。

examples.sentence: The fragmented nature of online discourse, where attention is constantly diverted by notifications, poses a serious challenge to deep reading and sustained critical thinking.
examples.trans: 网络话语的碎片化本质——注意力不断被通知打断——对深度阅读和持续的批判性思维构成了严峻挑战。

review.usageZh: 可作动词或名词。作动词时表示“复习、回顾、审查”，如 review the lessons（复习功课）、review a decision（重新审视决定）；作名词时表示“评论、回顾、复习”，如 a book review（书评）、an annual review（年度回顾）。口语和书面语都常用。

examples.sentence: I review my English words every evening after dinner.
examples.trans: 我每天晚饭后复习英语单词。

examples.sentence: Our teacher asked us to review the grammar rules before the test.
examples.trans: 老师让我们在考试前复习语法规则。

examples.sentence: Before making a final decision, the committee will review all the applications carefully.
examples.trans: 在做出最终决定之前，委员会将仔细审查所有申请。

examples.sentence: Having reviewed the evidence thoroughly, the researchers decided to repeat the experiment under stricter conditions.
examples.trans: 在彻底审查了证据之后，研究人员决定在更严格的条件下重复该实验。

examples.sentence: The editor asked me to review the manuscript not only for language errors but also for logical consistency.
examples.trans: 编辑让我审阅这份手稿，不仅要检查语言错误，还要检查逻辑一致性。

examples.sentence: A systematic review of existing studies reveals that fragmented sleep patterns are closely associated with impaired cognitive performance in adolescents.
examples.trans: 对现有研究的系统回顾表明，碎片化的睡眠模式与青少年认知能力下降密切相关。

with the development of.usageZh: 介词短语，后接名词或名词短语，表示“随着……的发展”。常用于句首作背景或原因状语，引出后续变化。书面语和口语均可使用，但更常见于说明文和议论文。

examples.sentence: With the development of our town, there are more buses now.
examples.trans: 随着我们小镇的发展，现在有更多公交车了。

examples.sentence: With the development of mobile phones, people can talk to friends far away easily.
examples.trans: 随着手机的发展，人们可以轻松地和远方的朋友通话。

examples.sentence: With the development of online shopping, many old stores have had to change their ways.
examples.trans: 随着网上购物的发展，许多老店不得不改变经营方式。

examples.sentence: With the development of artificial intelligence, machines are now able to perform tasks that once required human judgment.
examples.trans: 随着人工智能的发展，机器如今能够完成曾经需要人类判断力的任务。

examples.sentence: With the rapid development of medical technology, diseases that were once considered incurable can now be treated effectively.
examples.trans: 随着医疗技术的快速发展，曾经被认为无法治愈的疾病现在可以得到有效治疗。

examples.sentence: With the development of global communication networks, information spreads across continents within seconds, fundamentally reshaping how societies respond to crises.
examples.trans: 随着全球通信网络的发展，信息在数秒内跨越大洲传播，从根本上重塑了社会应对危机的方式。

as long as.usageZh: 连词短语，引导条件状语从句，表示“只要”。从句中通常用一般现在时表示将来意义。语气比 if 更强，强调条件的充分性。

examples.sentence: As long as you eat well, you will grow tall.
examples.trans: 只要你吃得好，你就会长高。

examples.sentence: As long as the weather is fine, we can have a picnic in the park.
examples.trans: 只要天气好，我们就可以在公园里野餐。

examples.sentence: As long as you keep practicing, your spoken English will improve a lot.
examples.trans: 只要你坚持练习，你的英语口语就会有很大提高。

examples.sentence: As long as the data is collected carefully, the results of the experiment should be reliable.
examples.trans: 只要数据收集得仔细，实验结果就应该是可靠的。

examples.sentence: As long as governments remain committed to reducing carbon emissions, there is still hope for slowing climate change.
examples.trans: 只要各国政府继续致力于减少碳排放，减缓气候变化就仍有希望。

examples.sentence: As long as the fundamental principles of fairness and transparency are upheld, institutional reform can proceed without undermining public trust.
examples.trans: 只要公平和透明的基本原则得到维护，制度改革就能在不损害公众信任的前提下推进。

keen on.usageZh: 形容词短语，后接名词或动名词，表示“对……有浓厚兴趣；热衷于”。英式英语中更常见，口语和书面语均可使用。

examples.sentence: My sister is keen on drawing cats.
examples.trans: 我妹妹热衷于画猫。

examples.sentence: Tom is keen on collecting stamps from different countries.
examples.trans: 汤姆热衷于收集不同国家的邮票。

examples.sentence: She is keen on learning Chinese history because she finds the stories fascinating.
examples.trans: 她热衷于学习中国历史，因为她觉得那些故事很迷人。

examples.sentence: Having grown up near the sea, he has always been keen on marine biology and hopes to study it at university.
examples.trans: 由于在海边长大，他一直对海洋生物学很感兴趣，希望能在大学学习这个专业。

examples.sentence: Unlike his classmates, who prefer team sports, Daniel is far more keen on individual challenges such as long-distance running.
examples.trans: 与喜欢团队运动的同学不同，丹尼尔对长跑这类个人挑战更感兴趣。

examples.sentence: Employers are increasingly keen on candidates who can demonstrate both technical expertise and the ability to collaborate across disciplines.
examples.trans: 雇主越来越青睐那些既能展示专业技术能力，又具备跨学科协作能力的求职者。

at a ... price.usageZh: 介词短语，中间常加形容词（如low, high, reasonable, fair），表示“以……的价格”。可作状语或表语，常用于购物、交易等场景。口语和书面语都常见，注意price前必须有不定冠词a/an。

examples.sentence: My mom bought the apples at a good price.
examples.trans: 我妈妈以很好的价格买了这些苹果。

examples.sentence: You can get fresh vegetables at a low price in that market.
examples.trans: 你可以在那个市场以低价买到新鲜蔬菜。

examples.sentence: The shop sold all its winter coats at a very low price before spring came.
examples.trans: 春天到来之前，这家商店以非常低的价格卖掉了所有冬衣。

examples.sentence: Having compared several stores online, she finally found the laptop at a reasonable price.
examples.trans: 在网上比较了几家商店之后，她终于以合理的价格找到了这台笔记本电脑。

examples.sentence: The rare first edition was sold at a surprisingly high price, far beyond what the auction house had expected.
examples.trans: 这本稀有的初版书以惊人的高价售出，远远超出了拍卖行的预期。

examples.sentence: While luxury brands rarely offer their products at a discounted price, this particular outlet store does so at the end of each season.
examples.trans: 虽然奢侈品牌很少以折扣价出售产品，但这家奥特莱斯店每逢季末都会这样做。

on most occasions.usageZh: 介词短语，作状语，表示“在大多数情况下、通常”。常置于句首或句中，语气比usually更正式一些。可用于描述习惯、规律或一般趋势。

examples.sentence: On most occasions, my dad walks me to school.
examples.trans: 大多数情况下，我爸爸走路送我上学。

examples.sentence: On most occasions, the bus arrives at this stop before eight o'clock.
examples.trans: 大多数情况下，公交车八点前到达这一站。

examples.sentence: On most occasions, the library remains quiet even when many students are studying there.
examples.trans: 大多数情况下，即使有很多学生在学习，图书馆也保持安静。

examples.sentence: On most occasions, taking notes by hand helps students remember key points more effectively than typing them.
examples.trans: 在大多数情况下，手写笔记比打字更能帮助学生有效记住要点。

examples.sentence: On most occasions, a well-structured argument carries more weight than an emotional appeal, though the latter can sometimes be decisive.
examples.trans: 在大多数情况下，结构严谨的论证比情感诉求更有分量，尽管后者有时也能起决定性作用。

examples.sentence: On most occasions, the committee reaches a consensus through careful deliberation rather than a simple majority vote.
examples.trans: 在大多数情况下，委员会通过审慎商议而非简单多数投票来达成共识。

fond of.usageZh: 形容词短语，be fond of后接名词、代词或动名词，表示“喜欢、喜爱”。语气比like更温和、含蓄，常用于描述长期或稳定的喜好。口语和书面语均可用。

examples.sentence: My little sister is fond of her new red shoes.
examples.trans: 我妹妹很喜欢她的新红鞋。

examples.sentence: My grandfather is fond of telling funny stories about his childhood.
examples.trans: 我爷爷喜欢讲他童年时的有趣故事。

examples.sentence: She is fond of collecting stamps from different countries, and she has over two hundred now.
examples.trans: 她喜欢收集不同国家的邮票，现在已经有两百多张了。

examples.sentence: Having grown up near the sea, he is particularly fond of swimming in open water rather than in a pool.
examples.trans: 由于在海边长大，他特别喜欢在开放水域游泳，而不是在游泳池里。

examples.sentence: Though he appears reserved in public, he is actually quite fond of lively discussions with close friends over dinner.
examples.trans: 尽管他在公共场合显得拘谨，实际上他非常喜欢与好友在晚餐时进行热烈的讨论。

examples.sentence: Scholars who are fond of tracing the origins of words often find that seemingly modern expressions have surprisingly ancient roots.
examples.trans: 喜欢追溯词语起源的学者常常发现，看似现代的表述其实有着令人惊讶的古老根源。

as for.usageZh: 介词短语，用于引出要谈论的另一个话题或方面，后接名词、代词或动名词。常放在句首，起到转换话题或补充说明的作用。口语和书面语中都很常见，语气比 about 更正式一些。

examples.sentence: I like apples. As for bananas, I don't like them.
examples.trans: 我喜欢苹果。至于香蕉，我不喜欢。

examples.sentence: My brother is good at math. As for me, I prefer English and history.
examples.trans: 我哥哥擅长数学。至于我，我更喜欢英语和历史。

examples.sentence: The hotel was clean and quiet. As for the food, it was better than we expected.
examples.trans: 酒店干净又安静。至于食物，比我们预期的要好。

examples.sentence: As for the students who missed the exam, they will have a chance to take it again next Monday.
examples.trans: 至于那些错过考试的学生，他们下周一将有机会补考。

examples.sentence: The report focuses on air pollution in cities; as for rural areas, the data is still being collected.
examples.trans: 这份报告聚焦于城市的空气污染；至于农村地区，数据仍在收集中。

examples.sentence: As for whether the new policy will actually reduce traffic congestion, experts remain divided on the issue.
examples.trans: 至于这项新政策是否真的能缓解交通拥堵，专家们在这个问题上仍存在分歧。

gained attention.usageZh: 动词短语，结构为 gain attention from sb.，意为“获得某人的关注”。gain 是及物动词，attention 为不可数名词。常与 from、of 搭配，也可用形容词修饰 attention，如 widespread attention、public attention。

examples.sentence: The little dog gained attention from everyone in the park.
examples.trans: 那只小狗引起了公园里每个人的注意。

examples.sentence: Her beautiful painting gained attention from the art teacher.
examples.trans: 她漂亮的画作引起了美术老师的注意。

examples.sentence: The young singer gained attention after she posted her first video online.
examples.trans: 这位年轻歌手在网上发布第一支视频后获得了关注。

examples.sentence: The discovery of the ancient tomb has gained attention from historians around the world.
examples.trans: 这座古墓的发现引起了全世界历史学家的关注。

examples.sentence: Unlike previous studies, this research gained attention not only from scientists but also from the general public.
examples.trans: 与以往的研究不同，这项研究不仅引起了科学家的关注，也引起了普通公众的关注。

examples.sentence: The documentary gained widespread attention for exposing the harsh realities faced by migrant workers in urban areas.
examples.trans: 这部纪录片因揭露了城市中农民工所面临的严酷现实而获得了广泛关注。

regard as.usageZh: 动词短语，结构为 regard A as B，意为“把A看作B”。as 是介词，后接名词、形容词或动名词。常用于表达观点、评价或判断。被动形式为 be regarded as，在书面语中非常常见。

examples.sentence: I regard my dog as my best friend.
examples.trans: 我把我的狗看作最好的朋友。

examples.sentence: Many students regard their English teacher as a helpful guide.
examples.trans: 许多学生把他们的英语老师看作一位有帮助的向导。

examples.sentence: People in the town regard the old library as an important part of their community.
examples.trans: 镇上的人们把这座老图书馆看作社区的重要组成部分。

examples.sentence: Scientists regard the discovery of penicillin as one of the greatest medical breakthroughs in history.
examples.trans: 科学家们把青霉素的发现视为历史上最伟大的医学突破之一。

examples.sentence: While some regard social media as a tool for connection, others view it as a major source of anxiety.
examples.trans: 虽然有些人把社交媒体视为连接的工具，但也有人把它看作焦虑的主要来源。

examples.sentence: The ability to think critically is widely regarded as an essential skill for navigating the complexities of the modern world.
examples.trans: 批判性思维能力被广泛认为是应对现代世界复杂性的一项基本技能。

make use of.usageZh: 动词短语，结构为 'make use of sth.'，意为“利用某物”。'Of' 是介词，后接名词或名词短语。可在 use 前加 good、full、better 等形容词表示利用的程度。口语和书面语均常用。

examples.sentence: We can make use of old boxes to keep our toys.
examples.trans: 我们可以利用旧箱子来放玩具。

examples.sentence: She made use of the sunny weather to wash her shoes.
examples.trans: 她趁着晴天把鞋子洗了。

examples.sentence: If you make good use of your notebook, it will help you review better.
examples.trans: 如果你好好利用笔记本，它会帮你更好地复习。

examples.sentence: The school encourages students to make full use of the library resources instead of relying only on the internet.
examples.trans: 学校鼓励学生充分利用图书馆资源，而不是只依赖网络。

examples.sentence: Rather than throwing away the leftover wood, the carpenter made use of every piece to build a small shelf.
examples.trans: 木匠没有扔掉剩余的木头，而是利用每一块木料做了一个小架子。

examples.sentence: A skilled negotiator knows how to make use of silence as a powerful tool to prompt the other side to reveal more information.
examples.trans: 熟练的谈判者懂得利用沉默这一有力工具，促使对方透露更多信息。

hot topic.usageZh: 名词短语，意为“热门话题”，指当前被广泛讨论的话题。常用作表语或宾语，如 'become a hot topic'、'discuss a hot topic'。可搭配 among、on campus、online 等表示讨论范围。

family.meaning: 有关时事的；热门话题的

examples.sentence: The new cartoon is a hot topic in our class.
examples.trans: 这部新动画片是我们班的热门话题。

examples.sentence: What to eat for lunch became a hot topic among my friends.
examples.trans: 午饭吃什么成了我朋友们之间的热门话题。

examples.sentence: Whether students should have mobile phones at school is still a hot topic.
examples.trans: 学生是否应该在学校带手机仍然是一个热门话题。

examples.sentence: The impact of artificial intelligence on future jobs has become a hot topic in recent public debates.
examples.trans: 人工智能对未来工作的影响已成为近期公众辩论中的热门话题。

examples.sentence: While climate change remains a hot topic globally, local communities often disagree on how to address its immediate effects.
examples.trans: 尽管气候变化在全球范围内仍是热门话题，但各地社区在如何应对其直接影响上往往意见不一。

examples.sentence: The ethics of gene editing, once confined to academic journals, has now emerged as a hot topic that demands both scientific insight and public scrutiny.
examples.trans: 基因编辑的伦理问题曾仅限于学术期刊，如今已成为一个既需要科学洞见又需要公众审视的热门话题。

renowned teachers.usageZh: 名词短语，'renowned' 为形容词，意为“著名的、有声望的”，修饰 'teachers'。常用于正式或书面语境，如学校介绍、新闻报道。可搭配 'invite'、'hire'、'learn from' 等动词。

examples.sentence: Our school invited two renowned teachers to give a music class.
examples.trans: 我们学校请了两位名师来上一节音乐课。

examples.sentence: Many students waited in line to ask the renowned teacher for advice.
examples.trans: 许多学生排队向那位名师请教。

examples.sentence: The online course was taught by several renowned teachers from different cities.
examples.trans: 这门网课由几位来自不同城市的名师讲授。

examples.sentence: Having studied under renowned teachers for years, she developed a unique approach to language teaching.
examples.trans: 在名师门下学习多年后，她形成了独特的语言教学方法。

examples.sentence: The program pairs young educators with renowned teachers, allowing them to observe masterful classroom management firsthand.
examples.trans: 该项目让年轻教师与名师结对，使他们能够亲眼观摩精湛的课堂管理技巧。

examples.sentence: Access to renowned teachers through digital platforms has narrowed the educational gap between urban and rural students, though infrastructure challenges persist.
examples.trans: 通过数字平台接触名师资源缩小了城乡学生之间的教育差距，尽管基础设施方面的挑战依然存在。

by themselves.usageZh: 介词短语，作方式状语，常位于句末修饰动词。意为“独自地；靠他们自己”，强调没有他人帮助。口语和书面语均可使用，主语通常为复数或不可数名词的复数概念。

family.meaning: 他们自己；她们自己；它们自己

examples.sentence: The twins made breakfast by themselves this morning.
examples.trans: 这对双胞胎今天早上自己做了早餐。

examples.sentence: My parents let me and my sister stay home by themselves for one hour.
examples.trans: 我父母让我和妹妹独自在家待了一个小时。

examples.sentence: After the teacher left, the students organized the class meeting by themselves.
examples.trans: 老师离开后，学生们自己组织了班会。

examples.sentence: The researchers designed the entire experiment by themselves without any outside funding.
examples.trans: 研究人员在没有任何外部资助的情况下，完全靠自己设计了这个实验。

examples.sentence: Rather than relying on the manual, the engineers figured out how to repair the machine by themselves.
examples.trans: 工程师们没有依赖手册，而是靠自己弄清楚了如何修理这台机器。

examples.sentence: Having been given only the raw data, the interns were expected to draw conclusions by themselves before the senior analysts reviewed their work.
examples.trans: 实习生们只拿到了原始数据，就被要求在资深分析师审核之前自行得出结论。

no matter where.usageZh: 让步状语从句引导词，意为“无论在哪里”，后接主语和谓语，引导的从句可置于主句前或主句后。语气比 wherever 更强调“地点不重要”。口语和书面语均常用。

family.meaning: 无论在哪里；在任何地方

examples.sentence: No matter where my cat hides, I can always find her.
examples.trans: 无论我的猫躲在哪里，我总能找到她。

examples.sentence: No matter where we go on vacation, my dad takes photos of the food.
examples.trans: 无论我们去哪里度假，我爸爸都会给食物拍照。

examples.sentence: No matter where you travel in China, you will find friendly people and delicious local food.
examples.trans: 无论你在中国哪里旅行，你都会遇到友好的人和美味的当地食物。

examples.sentence: No matter where the company opens a new branch, it maintains the same high service standards.
examples.trans: 无论公司在何处开设新分店，它都保持同样高的服务标准。

examples.sentence: No matter where the ancient tribe settled, they built their homes facing the rising sun.
examples.trans: 无论这个古老部落在哪里定居，他们都把房屋建得面向朝阳。

examples.sentence: No matter where groundbreaking research originates, its findings can reshape global scientific consensus within a matter of years.
examples.trans: 无论突破性研究起源于何处，其成果都能在短短数年内重塑全球科学共识。

are against.usageZh: 动词短语，结构为 'be against (doing) sth.'，意为“反对（做）某事”。'against' 是介词，后接名词、代词或动名词。反义表达为 'be for' 或 'be in favor of'。

examples.sentence: My little brother is against eating vegetables at dinner.
examples.trans: 我弟弟反对晚饭吃蔬菜。

examples.sentence: Many parents are against letting children use phones before bedtime.
examples.trans: 许多家长反对让孩子在睡前使用手机。

examples.sentence: Some local people are against pulling down the old library to build a shopping mall.
examples.trans: 一些当地人反对拆掉旧图书馆来建购物中心。

examples.sentence: Several board members are against investing in the new project until further market research is completed.
examples.trans: 几位董事会成员反对在完成进一步市场调研之前投资这个新项目。

examples.sentence: While the mayor supports the highway expansion, a growing number of residents are against sacrificing public parks for it.
examples.trans: 虽然市长支持扩建高速公路，但越来越多的居民反对为此牺牲公共公园。

examples.sentence: Economists who are against imposing sudden tariffs argue that such measures disrupt supply chains and ultimately harm domestic consumers.
examples.trans: 反对突然征收关税的经济学家认为，此类措施会扰乱供应链，最终损害国内消费者。

cut down the price.usageZh: 动词短语，'cut down' 意为“削减、减少”，后接 'the price' 作宾语，表示“降低价格”。也可说 'cut down on the price'，但 'cut down the price' 更直接。常用于商业、购物、谈判等语境，口语和书面语均可使用。

examples.sentence: The shop cut down the price of the toy to ten yuan.
examples.trans: 这家商店把玩具的价格降到了十元。

examples.sentence: If we buy two boxes, the seller will cut down the price for us.
examples.trans: 如果我们买两盒，卖家会给我们降价。

examples.sentence: The supermarket cut down the price of fresh milk because it would expire in two days.
examples.trans: 超市降低了鲜牛奶的价格，因为两天后就要过期了。

examples.sentence: After comparing several online stores, she finally found one that had cut down the price of the headphones by nearly thirty percent.
examples.trans: 在比较了几家网店之后，她终于找到一家把耳机价格降了近百分之三十的店。

examples.sentence: Rather than cutting down the price directly, the manager offered customers a free one-year warranty as an added incentive.
examples.trans: 经理没有直接降低价格，而是向顾客提供了一年免费保修作为额外激励。

examples.sentence: The manufacturer had little choice but to cut down the price of last year's models, as the release of the upgraded version had sharply reduced consumer demand for older inventory.
examples.trans: 制造商别无选择，只能降低去年型号的价格，因为升级版的发布使消费者对旧库存的需求急剧下降。

win-win pattern.usageZh: 名词短语，'win-win' 是复合形容词，意为“双赢的”，修饰名词 'pattern'（模式、格局）。常用来描述合作、谈判、商业模式等对各方都有利的安排。多用于商务、经济、社会评论等较正式的语境。

family.meaning: 双赢的；对各方都有利的

examples.sentence: Helping each other with homework is a win-win pattern for both of us.
examples.trans: 互相帮助做作业对我们俩来说是一种双赢模式。

examples.sentence: The school and the library created a win-win pattern by sharing books and study rooms.
examples.trans: 学校和图书馆通过共享图书和自习室，形成了一种双赢模式。

examples.sentence: When farmers sell their vegetables directly to restaurants, it becomes a win-win pattern because both sides save money.
examples.trans: 当农民把蔬菜直接卖给餐馆时，就形成了一种双赢模式，因为双方都省了钱。

examples.sentence: The partnership between the tech company and the local university has developed into a win-win pattern, with students gaining real work experience while the company receives fresh research support.
examples.trans: 这家科技公司与当地大学的合作已经发展成一种双赢模式：学生获得真实的工作经验，公司则得到新的研究支持。

examples.sentence: A true win-win pattern in international trade requires not only mutual tariff reductions but also a shared commitment to fair labor and environmental standards.
examples.trans: 国际贸易中真正的双赢模式不仅需要相互降低关税，还需要共同承诺公平的劳动和环境标准。

examples.sentence: The shift toward remote work has been widely described as a win-win pattern: employers reduce office overheads while employees gain flexibility, though long-term productivity data remains inconclusive.
examples.trans: 向远程办公的转变被广泛描述为一种双赢模式：雇主减少了办公开销，员工获得了灵活性，尽管长期生产力数据仍无定论。

in that case.usageZh: 介词短语，作状语，用于承接上文提到的情况，引出基于该情况的结果、决定或建议。口语和书面语均常用，通常置于句首，后接逗号。

examples.sentence: It is raining outside. In that case, take an umbrella with you.
examples.trans: 外面在下雨。那样的话，带把伞吧。

examples.sentence: You forgot your lunchbox. In that case, you can share my sandwich.
examples.trans: 你忘带午餐盒了。那样的话，你可以和我分吃三明治。

examples.sentence: The museum is closed on Mondays. In that case, we should change our plan and visit the park instead.
examples.trans: 博物馆周一闭馆。那样的话，我们应该改变计划，改去公园。

examples.sentence: If the train tickets are sold out, in that case we may have to consider renting a car for the trip.
examples.trans: 如果火车票卖完了，那样的话我们可能得考虑租车出行了。

examples.sentence: The client insists on a full refund; in that case, we have no choice but to review the contract terms carefully.
examples.trans: 客户坚持要求全额退款；那样的话，我们别无选择，只能仔细审查合同条款。

examples.sentence: Should the initial data prove unreliable, in that case the entire research methodology would need to be redesigned from scratch.
examples.trans: 如果初始数据被证明不可靠，那样的话，整个研究方法就需要从头重新设计。

in advance.usageZh: 介词短语，作状语，表示动作发生在预定时间之前。常与 book, pay, reserve, plan, notify 等动词搭配，也可单独使用。语体中性，口语和书面语均适用。

examples.sentence: Please tell me in advance if you can't come to my birthday party.
examples.trans: 如果你不能来我的生日聚会，请提前告诉我。

examples.sentence: My mom always pays the electricity bill in advance so we never worry about it.
examples.trans: 我妈妈总是提前交电费，所以我们从不担心。

examples.sentence: You should book the tickets in advance, because the show is very popular and seats sell out quickly.
examples.trans: 你应该提前订票，因为这场演出很受欢迎，座位很快售罄。

examples.sentence: Having prepared all the materials in advance, she felt confident walking into the interview room.
examples.trans: 提前准备好了所有材料，她自信地走进了面试室。

examples.sentence: The conference organizers require all speakers to submit their presentation slides at least one week in advance.
examples.trans: 会议组织者要求所有演讲者至少提前一周提交演示文稿。

examples.sentence: Given the complexity of the negotiation, it is prudent to circulate the draft proposal well in advance so that all parties have ample time to respond.
examples.trans: 鉴于谈判的复杂性，提前充分分发提案草案是明智的，以便各方有充足时间作出回应。

log on to.usageZh: 动词短语，后接系统、网站、应用或账户名称，表示通过输入用户名和密码进入数字平台。'log in to' 为常见变体，意义相同。语体偏日常和技术场景。

examples.sentence: I log on to the computer with my student number every morning.
examples.trans: 我每天早上用学号登录电脑。

examples.sentence: You need to log on to the library website before you can borrow e-books.
examples.trans: 你需要先登录图书馆网站，才能借电子书。

examples.sentence: If you forget your password, you won't be able to log on to your email account.
examples.trans: 如果你忘了密码，就无法登录你的电子邮箱账户。

examples.sentence: To access the online course materials, students are required to log on to the platform using their university credentials.
examples.trans: 要访问在线课程资料，学生需要使用大学凭证登录该平台。

examples.sentence: Employees are reminded not to log on to company systems from unsecured public Wi-Fi networks.
examples.trans: 员工被提醒不要通过不安全的公共 Wi-Fi 网络登录公司系统。

examples.sentence: Once you log on to the government portal with your verified digital identity, you can access a wide range of administrative services without visiting any office in person.
examples.trans: 一旦你用经过验证的数字身份登录政府门户网站，就可以在线办理各种行政服务，无需亲自前往任何办事处。

grammar.title: 被动语态：从基本结构到高考高频考点（含时态、情态动词、省略与语域拓展）
grammar.titleEn: Passive Voice: Structures, Tenses, Modals and Advanced Uses
grammar.usage:
被动语态的核心结构是“主语 + be 动词 + 过去分词（+ by 执行者）”。当说话人不知道动作执行者、不想指出执行者，或需要突出动作承受者时，常使用被动语态。肯定式如：The task was completed. 否定式在 be 动词后加 not：The task was not completed. 一般疑问句将 be 动词提前：Was the task completed? 特殊疑问句则用“疑问词 + be 动词 + 主语 + 过去分词”：When was the task completed?

初中阶段主要要求掌握一般现在时、一般过去时和一般将来时的被动语态，以及含情态动词的被动结构。高中阶段则进一步要求掌握现在完成时、过去完成时、现在进行时、过去进行时的被动语态，并能识别“get + 过去分词”表示被动或状态变化的口语化表达。此外，高中还常考查“be + 过去分词 + 不定式”结构，如 be said to do / be believed to have done，以及“have/get something done”表示“让别人做某事”或“遭遇某事”。

被动语态与主动语态的根本区别在于主语与动词的关系：主动语态中主语是动作执行者，被动语态中主语是动作承受者。例如：People speak English widely.（主动）与 English is widely spoken.（被动）。被动语态常与“系表结构”混淆：系表结构描述状态，被动语态强调动作。例如：The window is broken. 既可理解为“窗户是破的”（系表，描述状态），也可理解为“窗户被打破了”（被动，强调动作），需根据语境判断。

易错点一：不及物动词没有被动语态，如 happen, appear, disappear, remain, belong to 等。易错点二：感官动词和使役动词在被动语态中要还原不定式 to，如 He was made to work late. 易错点三：某些动词的主动形式表示被动意义，如 The book sells well. 和 The door won't open. 易错点四：by 短语并非总是必要，当执行者不明确或不重要时应省略，避免中式英语的过度使用。
forms: 一般现在时被动：主语 + am/is/are + 过去分词
一般过去时被动：主语 + was/were + 过去分词
一般将来时被动：主语 + will/shall + be + 过去分词
现在完成时被动：主语 + have/has + been + 过去分词
情态动词被动：主语 + 情态动词 + be + 过去分词
使役/感官被动：主语 + be + made/seen/heard + to do
notes: 高考书面语中，被动语态常用于科技文、新闻报道和学术写作，以体现客观性和正式语域。
注意“get + 过去分词”多用于口语和非正式文体，如 get hurt, get lost, get married，高考阅读中常出现，但书面表达中应谨慎使用。
“have/get something done”结构在高考中高频出现，既可表示“请人做某事”，也可表示“遭遇不幸”，如 have my bike repaired 与 have my wallet stolen。
某些动词如 sell, wash, write, read 用主动形式表被动意义时，常与副词连用，如 The pen writes smoothly. 高考语法填空和短文改错常考此点。
过去分词作后置定语时，相当于省略了“which/that + be”的被动定语从句，如 services provided on mobile phone = services which are provided on mobile phone，这是高考阅读长难句的常见结构。

examples.en: The classroom is cleaned every day.
examples.cn: 教室每天都被打扫。

examples.en: The bridge was built in 1998.
examples.cn: 这座桥建于1998年。

examples.en: The homework must be handed in before Friday.
examples.cn: 作业必须在周五之前上交。

examples.en: The new library has been open to students since last month.
examples.cn: 新图书馆自上个月起已对学生开放。

examples.en: It is said that the ancient city was destroyed by an earthquake.
examples.cn: 据说这座古城是被一场地震摧毁的。

examples.en: Having been informed of the change, all participants were required to reschedule their flights.
examples.cn: 在被告知变更后，所有参会者都被要求重新安排航班。

exercises.q: The classroom ______ every day.
exercises.explain: 主语 classroom 是动作的承受者，用一般现在时被动语态。

exercises.q: English ______ in many countries.
exercises.explain: English 是“被说”的语言，用被动语态。

exercises.q: The cake ______ by my mother yesterday.
exercises.explain: yesterday 提示过去时，cake 是“被做”的，用 was made。

exercises.q: These books ______ to the library next week.
exercises.explain: next week 提示将来时，books 是“被归还”，用 will be returned。

exercises.q: The windows ______ by Tom just now.
exercises.explain: just now 提示过去时，windows 是“被打碎”，用 were broken。

exercises.q: The homework ______ (do) by the students every day.
exercises.explain: 主语 homework 是动作承受者，用一般现在时被动语态。

exercises.q: The letter ______ (write) by Lucy last night.
exercises.explain: last night 提示过去时，letter 是“被写”，用 was written。

exercises.q: The room ______ (clean) every morning.
exercises.explain: every morning 提示一般现在时，room 是“被打扫”。

exercises.q: The song is sung by many people.
exercises.explain: song 是“被唱”的对象，被动语态结构正确。

exercises.q: The boy is cleaned the room.
exercises.explain: boy 是动作执行者，应用主动语态 cleans，而不是被动。

exercises.q: People grow rice in the south. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: Rice is grown in the south.
exercises.explain: 宾语 rice 变为主语，动词用 is grown。

exercises.q: The car was repaired by the worker. (改为主动语态)
exercises.explain: by 后的执行者变为主语，动词改为主动过去式。

exercises.q: They make cars in this factory. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: Cars are made in this factory.
exercises.explain: 宾语 cars 变为主语，动词用 are made。

exercises.q: The homework are done by the students.
exercises.answer: The homework is done by the students.
exercises.explain: homework 是不可数名词，be 动词应用 is。

exercises.q: The letter was wrote by Tom.
exercises.answer: The letter was written by Tom.
exercises.explain: write 的过去分词是 written，不是 wrote。

exercises.q: A new library ______ in our school last year.
exercises.explain: last year 提示过去时，library 是“被建”，用 was built。

exercises.q: The work ______ by the time the teacher came in.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导过去时间，强调“已经完成”，用过去完成时被动。

exercises.q: These trees ______ next spring.
exercises.explain: next spring 提示将来时，trees 是“被种植”。

exercises.q: The room ______ when I arrived.
exercises.explain: arrived 提示过去某时刻正在进行的被动动作，用过去进行时被动。

exercises.q: The problem ______ by the students now.
exercises.explain: now 提示此刻正在进行的被动动作，用现在进行时被动。

exercises.q: The bridge ______ (build) two years ago.
exercises.explain: two years ago 提示过去时，bridge 是“被建造”。

exercises.q: The flowers ______ (water) by my mother every day.
exercises.explain: every day 提示一般现在时，flowers 是“被浇水”。

exercises.q: The homework ______ (must finish) before class.
exercises.explain: 情态动词被动结构为 must be + 过去分词。

exercises.q: The book was wrote by a famous writer.
exercises.explain: write 的过去分词是 written，不是 wrote。

exercises.q: The dishes are being washed by my sister now.
exercises.explain: now 提示现在进行时被动，结构正确。

exercises.q: The teacher gave the students a test. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: The students were given a test by the teacher.
exercises.explain: 间接宾语 students 变为主语，动词用 were given。

exercises.q: The song can be sung by everyone. (改为主动语态)
exercises.explain: by 后的执行者变为主语，情态动词后接动词原形。

exercises.q: They are repairing the road. (改为被动语态)
exercises.explain: 现在进行时被动结构为 is/are being + 过去分词。

exercises.q: The children are taken good care by the nurses.
exercises.answer: The children are taken good care of by the nurses.
exercises.explain: take care of 是固定短语，被动语态中 of 不能省略。

exercises.q: The work has been finished by them yesterday.
exercises.answer: The work was finished by them yesterday.
exercises.explain: yesterday 是过去时间，不能用现在完成时，应用一般过去时被动。

exercises.q: The decision ______ by the committee before the meeting ended.
exercises.explain: before the meeting ended 提示过去某时间之前已完成，用过去完成时被动。

exercises.q: The new policy is expected ______ into effect next month.
exercises.explain: expect 后接不定式，policy 与 put 是被动关系，用 to be put。

exercises.q: The house ______ by the time we arrived.
exercises.explain: by the time we arrived 提示过去完成时，house 是“被卖”。

exercises.q: The report ______ to the manager before the meeting started.
exercises.explain: before the meeting started 提示过去完成时被动。

exercises.q: The problem ______ at the meeting tomorrow.
exercises.explain: tomorrow 提示将来时，problem 是“被讨论”。

exercises.q: The project ______ (complete) by the end of last month.
exercises.explain: by the end of last month 提示过去完成时被动。

exercises.q: The letter ______ (send) to the wrong address yesterday.
exercises.explain: yesterday 提示过去时，letter 是“被寄送”。

exercises.q: The results ______ (announce) at the meeting next week.
exercises.explain: next week 提示将来时，results 是“被宣布”。

exercises.q: The novel is said to have been translated into many languages.
exercises.explain: 不定式完成被动式 to have been translated 表示已完成的被动动作。

exercises.q: The work is needed to do by the students.
exercises.explain: work 与 do 是被动关系，应用 to be done。

exercises.q: People believe that he is a good doctor. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: He is believed to be a good doctor.
exercises.explain: believe 的被动结构为 be believed to do，表示“被认为”。

exercises.q: The teacher made the students clean the classroom. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: The students were made to clean the classroom.
exercises.explain: make 在被动语态中要还原 to，即 be made to do。

exercises.q: They are going to build a new hospital here. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: A new hospital is going to be built here.
exercises.explain: be going to 的被动结构为 be going to be + 过去分词。

exercises.q: The problem is too difficult to be solved by the students.
exercises.answer: The problem is too difficult to solve for the students.
exercises.explain: too...to 结构中，若主语是动词的逻辑宾语，不定式用主动形式。

exercises.q: The window was broken by the boy who name is Tom.
exercises.answer: The window was broken by the boy whose name is Tom.
exercises.explain: 定语从句中表示“某人的名字”应用 whose，不是 who。

exercises.q: The new library ______ last year and it is now open to all students.
exercises.explain: last year 表明过去时间，图书馆是被建造，用一般过去时被动。

exercises.q: English ______ in many countries around the world.
exercises.explain: 英语是被说，用一般现在时被动，主语是单数。

exercises.q: The windows ______ by Tom yesterday afternoon.
exercises.explain: yesterday afternoon 表过去，窗户被擦，主语复数用 were。

exercises.q: This song ______ by a famous singer in 2010.
exercises.explain: in 2010 是过去时间，歌曲被写，用一般过去时被动。

exercises.q: The homework ______ every day, so we have no time to play.
exercises.explain: every day 表习惯，作业被布置，用一般现在时被动。

exercises.q: The classroom ______ (clean) every morning by the students.
exercises.explain: every morning 表习惯，教室被学生打扫，用一般现在时被动。

exercises.q: These photos ______ (take) on the school trip last week.
exercises.explain: last week 表过去，照片被拍，主语复数用 were taken。

exercises.q: The cake ______ (make) by my mother yesterday.
exercises.explain: yesterday 表过去，蛋糕被做，主语单数用 was made。

exercises.q: The letter was wrote by Mary last night.
exercises.explain: write 的过去分词是 written，不是 wrote。

exercises.q: These trees are planted every spring.

grammar.key: Present Perfect Tense / 现在完成时
grammar.title: 现在完成时：从基本结构到与一般过去时的辨析（含 since/for、already/yet、have been to/have gone to 等拓展）
grammar.titleEn: Present Perfect Tense: Core Structure, Time Markers and Contrast with Simple Past
grammar.usage:
现在完成时的核心结构是“have/has + 过去分词”，用来连接过去与现在。它主要有两种用法：一是表示过去发生的动作对现在造成的影响或结果，例如“I have lost my key”意味着现在钥匙不见了；二是表示从过去某一时间开始一直持续到现在的动作或状态，常与 since、for、in recent years、so far、up to now 等时间状语连用。
肯定句结构为“主语 + have/has + 过去分词”，否定句在 have/has 后加 not，疑问句把 have/has 提到主语之前。例如：Have you ever tried online shopping? Yes, I have. / No, I haven't. 注意 have/has 的选择取决于主语的人称和数，第三人称单数用 has，其余用 have。
与一般过去时的对比是高中阶段的核心难点。一般过去时只陈述过去某一具体时间发生的动作，与现在没有联系，常与 yesterday、last week、in 2019、two days ago 等明确的过去时间连用；而现在完成时强调过去动作与现在的联系或持续，不能与表示纯粹过去的时间状语连用。例如“I saw the film yesterday”只说明昨天看了电影；“I have seen the film”则强调现在知道电影内容，或者不想再看。
初中阶段主要要求掌握现在完成时的基本构成、already/yet/just/ever/never 等常见标志词，以及 have been to（去过某地，人已回来）与 have gone to（去了某地，人还没回来）的区别。高中阶段则进一步要求理解现在完成时与一般过去时在语境中的细微差异，掌握 since 从句中主从句时态的搭配，识别 in recent years、over the past decade、during the last few months 等“近段时间”类时间状语，并能在定语从句、被动语态等复杂结构中正确使用现在完成时。
易错点一：把现在完成时与具体过去时间连用。不能说“I have seen him yesterday”，应改为“I saw him yesterday”或“I have seen him before”。易错点二：混淆 have been to 与 have gone to。前者表示“去过某地，已回来”，后者表示“去了某地，还没回来”。易错点三：since 从句中误用一般现在时。since 引导的时间状语从句通常用一般过去时，主句用现在完成时，例如“He has worked here since he graduated”。易错点四：非延续性动词与 for/since 连用问题。come、go、leave、die、buy 等短暂性动词不能直接与表示一段时间的 for/since 连用，需转换为延续性表达，如“He has been away for two weeks”而不是“He has left for two weeks”。
forms: 肯定句：主语 + have/has + 过去分词（+ 其他）
否定句：主语 + have/has + not + 过去分词（+ 其他）
一般疑问句：Have/Has + 主语 + 过去分词（+ 其他）？
特殊疑问句：疑问词 + have/has + 主语 + 过去分词（+ 其他）？
since + 过去时间点/一般过去时从句，主句用现在完成时
have been to + 地点（去过已回） / have gone to + 地点（去了未回）
notes: 高考高频考点：现在完成时与一般过去时在同一语境中的辨析。判断标准是看句子是否强调“对现在的影响”或“持续到现在”，而不是只看时间状语。
书面语中，in recent years、over the past few years、during the last decade 等短语常与现在完成时连用，表示从过去某时延续到现在的趋势或变化。
since 引导时间状语从句时，从句用一般过去时，主句用现在完成时；但“It is/has been + 一段时间 + since + 一般过去时从句”是固定句型，注意 It is 和 It has been 均可。
短暂性动词（如 leave、arrive、die、buy、join）不能与 for + 一段时间连用，需转换为 be away、be here、be dead、have、be in 等延续性表达，这是高考语法填空和短文改错的常考点。
在定语从句中，现在完成时的 have/has 需与先行词保持人称和数的一致，例如“the changes that have taken place”中 have 与复数先行词 changes 一致。

exercises.q: I ______ my homework, so I can go out to play now.

exercises.q: She ______ in this city since 2018.
