exercises.q: She have lived here for five years.
exercises.answer: She has lived here for five years.
exercises.explain: 主语 she 是第三人称单数，现在完成时应用 has 而非 have。

exercises.q: I didn't see him since Monday.
exercises.answer: I haven't seen him since Monday.
exercises.explain: since Monday 表示从过去持续到现在，需用现在完成时而非一般过去时。

exercises.q: By the time we got to the cinema, the film ______ already ______.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导过去时间，主句动作发生在“到达”之前，用过去完成时。

exercises.q: This is the first time that I ______ such a beautiful sunset.
exercises.explain: This is the first time 后接现在完成时，表示“这是第一次做某事”。

exercises.q: He ______ in the company since he graduated from college.
exercises.explain: since 引导时间状语从句，主句用现在完成进行时强调动作从过去持续到现在且仍在进行。

exercises.q: I ______ my keys. I can't find them anywhere.
exercises.explain: 丢钥匙对现在造成影响“找不到”，用现在完成时强调结果。

exercises.q: She said she ______ the book twice already.
exercises.explain: 主句为过去时，宾语从句中表示“已经读过两次”需用过去完成时。

exercises.q: By the end of last month, they ______ (complete) the project.
exercises.explain: by the end of last month 是过去完成时的标志，表示到过去某时已完成的动作。

exercises.q: It is the most interesting book I ______ ever ______ (read).
exercises.explain: 最高级 + ever 常与现在完成时连用，表示“曾经读过的最有趣的书”。

exercises.q: He ______ (be) to the Great Wall three times.
exercises.explain: have/has been to 表示“去过某地”，three times 表示次数。

exercises.q: I have bought this bike for two years.
exercises.explain: buy 是短暂性动词，不能与 for two years 连用，应改为 have had。

exercises.q: He has gone to Beijing, so he is not here now.
exercises.explain: has gone to 表示“去了某地未回来”，与“现在不在这里”相符。

exercises.q: I bought this book three years ago. (用 for three years 改写)
exercises.answer: I have had this book for three years.
exercises.explain: buy 是短暂动词，不能与 for 连用，需改为延续性动词 have。

exercises.q: He has never been to Japan. (改为反意疑问句)
exercises.answer: He has never been to Japan, has he?
exercises.explain: 现在完成时反意疑问句，前句否定，后句用肯定形式 has he。

exercises.q: The meeting began half an hour ago. (用 has been on 改写)
exercises.answer: The meeting has been on for half an hour.
exercises.explain: begin 是短暂动词，用 has been on 表示状态持续半小时。

exercises.q: He has joined the army for three years.
exercises.answer: He has been in the army for three years.
exercises.explain: join 是短暂性动词，不能与 for 连用，应改为 be in。

exercises.q: She has gone to Shanghai twice.
exercises.answer: She has been to Shanghai twice.
exercises.explain: 表示“去过某地”且已回来，应用 has been to，而非 has gone to。

exercises.q: It is the second time that the company ______ its online shopping platform.
exercises.explain: It is the second time 后接现在完成时，表示“这是第二次做某事”。

exercises.q: By the time the new policy was introduced, online shopping ______ a common consuming habit.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导过去时间，主句动作先于从句发生，用过去完成时。

exercises.q: The youngsters as well as the elderly ______ keen on shopping online in recent years.
exercises.explain: as well as 连接主语时谓语与前面的名词一致，the youngsters 为复数，用 have been。

exercises.q: Hardly ______ the office when it began to rain.
exercises.explain: Hardly...when 句型中，hardly 置于句首需部分倒装，且用过去完成时。

exercises.q: She is the only one of the students who ______ the scholarship three times.
exercises.explain: the only one of + 复数名词作先行词时，定语从句谓语用单数，且 three times 暗示用现在完成时。

exercises.q: Not until he graduated ______ he ______ (realize) the importance of time management.
exercises.explain: Not until 置于句首，主句需部分倒装，且用一般过去时。

exercises.q: The number of online shoppers ______ (increase) dramatically over the past decade.
exercises.explain: over the past decade 是现在完成时标志，the number 作主语谓语用单数。

exercises.q: It was the first time that I ______ (see) such a complicated system.
exercises.explain: It was the first time 后接过去完成时，表示“那是第一次做某事”。

exercises.q: The company has been established for over twenty years.
exercises.explain: establish 是短暂性动词，不能与 for over twenty years 连用，应改为 has been in existence。

exercises.q: No sooner had the website been launched than it attracted millions of users.
exercises.explain: No sooner...than 句型用过去完成时，且 no sooner 置于句首需倒装，用法正确。

exercises.q: He began to work here five years ago. (用 since 改写)
exercises.answer: He has worked here since five years ago.
exercises.explain: since five years ago 表示从五年前持续到现在，主句用现在完成时。

exercises.q: I have never read such an inspiring novel. (改为倒装句)
exercises.answer: Never have I read such an inspiring novel.
exercises.explain: never 置于句首，句子需部分倒装，将 have 提前。

exercises.q: The last time I saw him was ten years ago. (用现在完成时改写)
exercises.answer: I haven't seen him for ten years.
exercises.explain: 用现在完成时否定形式表达“已经十年没见他了”。

exercises.q: The number of people who shops online have increased sharply.
exercises.answer: The number of people who shop online has increased sharply.
exercises.explain: who 引导定语从句修饰 people，谓语用 shop；主句主语 the number 为单数，用 has increased。

exercises.q: It has been five years since he has left his hometown.
exercises.answer: It has been five years since he left his hometown.
exercises.explain: since 从句中用一般过去时，不用现在完成时。

grammar.key: Conditional Sentences (Type 1) / 条件句（第一类）
grammar.title: 第一类条件句：真实条件（含 if / unless / 主句 will / can / may / should / 祈使句）
grammar.titleEn: Conditional Sentences (Type 1): Real Conditionals with if / unless and Main-Clause Modals
grammar.usage:
第一类条件句用于谈论现在或将来可能发生的真实情况，以及在该情况成立时很可能产生的结果。其核心结构是：if 引导的条件从句使用一般现在时，主句使用一般将来时（will）或情态动词（can / may / should / must 等）加动词原形。例如：If the product is damaged, we can return it and get a refund. 条件从句说明可能发生的条件，主句说明条件实现后的结果或可采取的行动。

肯定句中，条件从句和主句都按正常语序排列；否定句可以在从句或主句中分别使用 not。例如：If you don't like the item, you won't keep it. 疑问句通常对主句提问，而 if 从句保持陈述语序，例如：What will you do if the package doesn't arrive? 也可以对条件本身提问，但此时往往改用其他结构。

第一类条件句与第二类条件句的区别在于：第一类表示说话人认为条件实现的可能性较大，是真实条件；第二类（If + 过去时, would + 动词原形）表示假设或可能性较小的情况。高中阶段还需要掌握 unless（= if...not）引导的条件句，例如：Unless you confirm the order, the seller won't ship it. 此外，主句除 will 外，常用 can 表示能力或可能性，may 表示许可或不太确定的结果，should 表示建议，祈使句则表示指令或提醒，例如：If you see a lower price, tell us immediately.

初中阶段主要要求掌握“主将从现”的基本时态搭配，即 if 从句用一般现在时，主句用 will 或 can。高中阶段则进一步要求：第一，能根据语境选择恰当的情态动词，区分 will（较确定的结果）、may（较不确定的结果）、can（能力或客观可能）、should（建议）；第二，能正确使用 unless 替换 if...not，并注意 unless 从句本身不再用否定式；第三，能在书面表达中灵活使用祈使句主句，使建议或说明更加简洁有力；第四，能识别条件句与其他从句的区别，避免在主句和从句的时态上出现混淆。

易错点一：在 if 从句中误用 will 或 would。第一类条件句的 if 从句必须用一般现在时表示将来条件，不能说 If it will rain tomorrow。易错点二：主句误用一般现在时。主句应使用 will、情态动词或祈使句，而不是一般现在时，例如不能说 If it rains, we stay at home，而应说 we will stay at home。易错点三：unless 从句中误加否定词。unless 本身已含否定意义，不能说 unless you don't hurry，而应说 unless you hurry。易错点四：混淆第一类与第二类条件句。如果条件实现的可能性很小或纯属假设，应使用第二类条件句，而不是第一类。
forms: If + 一般现在时, 主句 will + 动词原形
If + 一般现在时, 主句 can / may / should / must + 动词原形
If + 一般现在时, 主句祈使句
Unless + 一般现在时, 主句 will / can / may + 动词原形
主句 + if + 一般现在时（if 从句后置，前面不加逗号）
If + 一般现在时（否定式：don't / doesn't + 动词原形）, 主句 won't / can't + 动词原形
notes: 高考书面表达中，if 从句用一般现在时表将来是硬性规则，写作时不要受汉语“如果明天会下雨”影响而写成 If it will rain。
在正式语域中，unless 比 if...not 更简洁，但要注意 unless 本身已含否定，从句不再用 not。
主句用 may 时，表示结果不如 will 确定，常用于对可能性的谨慎表达，高考阅读和写作中需根据语境区分。
当主句是祈使句时，语气更直接，常见于说明书、通知或建议类文本，书面表达中可用来增强条理性。
第一类条件句的主句也可以用 be going to 表示打算或预测，但语气比 will 更口语化，正式写作中优先使用 will 或情态动词。

examples.en: If you touch the fire, you will get burned.
examples.cn: 如果你碰火，你会被烧伤。

examples.en: If it is sunny tomorrow, we can go to the park.
examples.cn: 如果明天是晴天，我们可以去公园。

examples.en: If you don't water the plants, they will die.
examples.cn: 如果你不给植物浇水，它们会死。

examples.en: If the product doesn't match the description, you may ask for a full refund.
examples.cn: 如果产品与描述不符，你可以要求全额退款。

examples.en: Unless we take immediate action, the problem will become more serious.
examples.cn: 除非我们立即采取行动，否则问题会变得更严重。

examples.en: Should you have any further questions, please do not hesitate to contact our customer service team.
examples.cn: 如果您还有任何其他问题，请随时联系我们的客服团队。

exercises.q: If it rains tomorrow, we ______ at home.
exercises.explain: 第一类条件句遵循“主将从现”，主句用将来时。

exercises.q: If you ______ hard, you will pass the exam.
exercises.explain: if 引导的条件从句用一般现在时表示将来。

exercises.q: She can go out and play if she ______ her homework.
exercises.explain: 条件从句中用一般现在时，主语 she 是第三人称单数，动词加 -es。

exercises.q: If you feel tired, you ______ a short rest.
exercises.explain: 主句可以用情态动词 can 加动词原形表示可能。

exercises.q: If he ______ late again, the teacher will be angry.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时，主语 he 用 is。

exercises.q: If you ______ (feel) hungry, you can eat some bread.
exercises.explain: if 引导的条件从句用一般现在时。

exercises.q: We will go to the park if the weather ______ (be) nice.
exercises.explain: 条件从句中用一般现在时，主语 the weather 用 is。

exercises.q: If she ______ (call) me, I will tell her the news.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时，主语 she 是第三人称单数。

exercises.q: If it will rain tomorrow, we will stay at home.
exercises.explain: if 从句中不能用将来时，应改为一般现在时 rains。

exercises.q: If you study hard, you can get good grades.
exercises.explain: 第一类条件句结构正确：if 从句用一般现在时，主句用情态动词 can。

exercises.q: If you don't hurry, you will miss the bus. (改为肯定句)
exercises.answer: If you hurry, you will catch the bus.
exercises.explain: 将否定条件改为肯定条件，主句结果也相应变为肯定。

exercises.q: We can go swimming if the sun shines. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: We can't go swimming if the sun doesn't shine.
exercises.explain: 将主句和从句都改为否定形式。

exercises.q: If you eat too much, you will get fat. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Will I get fat if I eat too much?
exercises.explain: 将主句改为疑问句形式，if 从句保持一般现在时。

exercises.q: If he will come, I will call you.
exercises.answer: If he comes, I will call you.
exercises.explain: if 从句中不能用 will，应改为一般现在时 comes。

exercises.q: You can watch TV if you will finish your homework.
exercises.answer: You can watch TV if you finish your homework.
exercises.explain: if 从句中不能用 will，应改为一般现在时 finish。

exercises.q: If you ______ to the party, you will meet many new friends.
exercises.explain: 第一类条件句的 if 从句用一般现在时。

exercises.q: We ______ the match if it doesn't rain.
exercises.explain: 主句用一般将来时，表示条件成立后会发生的结果。

exercises.q: If she ______ enough money, she may buy a new phone.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时，主句用情态动词 may 表示可能。

exercises.q: You should see a doctor if you ______ sick.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时，主句用 should 表示建议。

exercises.q: If the bus ______ on time, we won't be late.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时，主语 the bus 是第三人称单数。

exercises.q: If you ______ (not water) the plants, they will die.
exercises.explain: if 从句的否定形式用 don't + 动词原形。

exercises.q: She ______ (may get) a prize if she wins the competition.
exercises.explain: 主句用情态动词 may 加动词原形表示可能性。

exercises.q: If Tom ______ (not hurry), he will be late for school.
exercises.explain: if 从句主语是第三人称单数，否定形式用 doesn't + 动词原形。

exercises.q: If you will help me, I will finish the work faster.
exercises.explain: if 从句中不能用 will，应改为一般现在时 help。

exercises.q: If he studies harder, he can improve his English.
exercises.explain: 第一类条件句结构正确，主句用 can 表示能力或可能。

exercises.q: If you don't leave now, you will miss the train. (用 unless 改写)
exercises.answer: Unless you leave now, you will miss the train.
exercises.explain: unless 相当于 if...not，表示“如果不”。

exercises.q: She can pass the test if she reviews the lessons. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: She can't pass the test if she doesn't review the lessons.
exercises.explain: 将主句和从句都改为否定形式。

exercises.q: If you practice every day, you will become better. (用 can 改写主句)
exercises.answer: If you practice every day, you can become better.
exercises.explain: 主句可以用情态动词 can 替代 will 表示可能性。

exercises.q: If the weather will be good, we will go hiking.
exercises.answer: If the weather is good, we will go hiking.
exercises.explain: if 从句中不能用 will，应改为一般现在时 is。

exercises.q: You will get wet if you don't will take an umbrella.
exercises.answer: You will get wet if you don't take an umbrella.
exercises.explain: if 从句的否定形式是 don't + 动词原形，不能加 will。

exercises.q: If the product ______ damaged when it arrives, you can return it and get a refund.
exercises.explain: 第一类条件句的 if 从句用一般现在时表示将来可能发生的情况。

exercises.q: You ______ a full refund if you return the item within seven days.
exercises.explain: 主句用一般将来时，表示条件成立后的结果。

exercises.q: If the seller ______ the wrong size, you may ask for an exchange.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时，主语 the seller 是第三人称单数。

exercises.q: If you ______ the instructions carefully, you won't have any problems.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时，主句用将来时的否定形式。

exercises.q: The company ______ a replacement if the product doesn't work.
exercises.explain: 主句用一般将来时，表示在条件成立时将会发生的动作。

exercises.q: If the customer ______ (not be) satisfied with the service, he can make a complaint.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时，否定形式用 isn't。

exercises.q: You ______ (should check) the size carefully before you place an order.
exercises.explain: 主句用情态动词 should 加动词原形表示建议。

exercises.q: If the package ______ (arrive) late, we will contact the delivery company.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时，主语 the package 是第三人称单数。

exercises.q: If you will find a lower price elsewhere, we will match it.
exercises.explain: if 从句中不能用 will，应改为一般现在时 find。

exercises.q: If the item is out of stock, the website will notify you immediately.
exercises.explain: 第一类条件句结构正确，if 从句用一般现在时，主句用将来时。

exercises.q: If you don't like the product, you can return it. (用 unless 改写)
exercises.answer: Unless you like the product, you can return it.
exercises.explain: unless 相当于 if...not，注意主句的逻辑要保持一致。

exercises.q: The store will give you a refund if you show the receipt. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: The store won't give you a refund if you don't show the receipt.
exercises.explain: 将主句和从句都改为否定形式。

exercises.q: If you contact customer service, they can help you solve the problem. (用 be able to 改写)
exercises.answer: If you contact customer service, they will be able to help you solve the problem.
exercises.explain: can 可以转换为 will be able to，表示将来的能力或可能性。

exercises.q: If the order will be delayed, the company will send you an email.
exercises.answer: If the order is delayed, the company will send you an email.
exercises.explain: if 从句中不能用 will，应改为一般现在时的被动语态 is delayed。

exercises.q: You can get a full refund if you will return the item within 30 days.
exercises.answer: You can get a full refund if you return the item within 30 days.
exercises.explain: if 从句中不能用 will，应改为一般现在时 return。

exercises.q: If it rains tomorrow, we ______ at home.
exercises.explain: 第一类条件句遵循“主将从现”，主句用将来时。

exercises.q: If you ______ hard, you will pass the exam.
exercises.explain: if 引导的条件从句用一般现在时表示将来。

exercises.q: She can go to the party if she ______ her homework first.
exercises.explain: 条件从句中即使主句有情态动词，从句仍用一般现在时。

exercises.q: If the bus ______ late, we will take a taxi.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时，不能用将来时。

exercises.q: You ______ the game if you practice every day.
exercises.explain: 主句表示可能的结果，用 will + 动词原形。

exercises.q: If Tom ______ (come) to the party, he will meet many new friends.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时，主语 Tom 是第三人称单数。

exercises.q: We will go to the beach if the weather ______ (be) nice tomorrow.
exercises.explain: 条件从句用一般现在时表示将来的情况。

exercises.q: If you don't hurry, you ______ (miss) the train.
exercises.explain: 主句表示可能的结果，用 will + 动词原形。

exercises.q: If he will come tomorrow, I will tell him the news.
exercises.explain: if 从句不能用将来时，应改为 If he comes tomorrow。

exercises.q: If you mix red and blue, you get purple.
exercises.explain: 表示客观事实或普遍规律时，主句和从句都用一般现在时。

exercises.q: If you don't study hard, you will fail the exam. (改为肯定句)
exercises.answer: If you study hard, you will pass the exam.
exercises.explain: 将否定条件改为肯定条件，同时主句结果也需相应调整。

exercises.q: She will be happy if she gets the gift. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Will she be happy if she gets the gift?
exercises.explain: 将主句的 will 提前构成一般疑问句，if 从句语序不变。

exercises.q: If you feel tired, you can take a rest. (用 should 改写)
exercises.answer: If you feel tired, you should take a rest.
exercises.explain: 第一类条件句主句可用情态动词 should 表示建议。

exercises.q: If it will snow tomorrow, we will make a snowman.
exercises.answer: If it snows tomorrow, we will make a snowman.
exercises.explain: if 从句中不能用 will，应改为一般现在时 snows。

exercises.q: You can borrow the book if you will return it on time.
exercises.answer: You can borrow the book if you return it on time.
exercises.explain: 条件从句用一般现在时，去掉 will。

exercises.q: If you ______ the instructions carefully, you won't make mistakes.
exercises.explain: if 条件从句用一般现在时表示将来。

exercises.q: We ______ the match if our best player is injured.
exercises.explain: 主句表示在某种条件下可能发生的结果，用 will + 动词原形。

exercises.q: If the product doesn't work properly, you ______ a refund.
exercises.explain: 主句用情态动词 can 表示可能或权利，符合第一类条件句结构。

exercises.q: Unless you ______ now, you will be late for school.
exercises.explain: unless 相当于 if...not，从句同样用一般现在时。

exercises.q: If she ______ enough money, she may buy a new phone.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时，主句可用 may 表示可能性。

exercises.q: If you ______ (not water) the plants, they will die.
exercises.explain: if 从句的否定形式用 don't + 动词原形。

exercises.q: He ______ (be able to) finish the project if he works overtime.
exercises.explain: be able to 在将来时中表示“能够”，主句用 will be able to。

exercises.q: If the traffic ______ (be) heavy, we may miss the flight.
exercises.explain: 条件从句用一般现在时，主句用 may 表示可能性。

exercises.q: If you will see John, please give him this message.
exercises.explain: if 从句中不能用 will，应改为 If you see John。

exercises.q: If the weather is good, we might go hiking this weekend.
exercises.explain: 第一类条件句主句可用 might 表示较小的可能性。

exercises.q: If you don't apologize, she won't forgive you. (用 unless 改写)
exercises.answer: Unless you apologize, she won't forgive you.
exercises.explain: unless 相当于 if...not，可替换否定条件句。

exercises.q: He can attend the meeting if he finishes his report. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: He can't attend the meeting if he doesn't finish his report.
exercises.explain: 主句和从句同时改为否定形式，保持逻辑一致。

exercises.q: If you practice speaking English every day, your spoken English will improve. (用 be able to 改写主句)
exercises.answer: If you practice speaking English every day, you will be able to improve your spoken English.
exercises.explain: will be able to 可替代 will 表示将来的能力。

exercises.q: If the machine will break down, call the technician immediately.
exercises.answer: If the machine breaks down, call the technician immediately.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时，不能用 will。

exercises.q: You should see a doctor if you will feel dizzy again.
exercises.answer: You should see a doctor if you feel dizzy again.
exercises.explain: 条件从句中用一般现在时，去掉 will。

exercises.q: If the experiment ______ successful, the researchers will publish their findings.
exercises.explain: if 条件从句用一般现在时，即使主句主语是 researchers。

exercises.q: Should you require any further information, please ______ our customer service department.
exercises.explain: Should you require 是倒装条件句，主句用祈使句表示建议。

exercises.q: If the company ______ its policies, it may lose many loyal customers.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时，主句用 may 表示可能的结果。

exercises.q: Provided that the data ______ accurate, we can proceed with the analysis.
exercises.explain: provided that 引导条件从句，用一般现在时表示条件。

exercises.q: If he ______ the opportunity, he would have accepted the offer.
exercises.explain: 这是与过去事实相反的虚拟条件句，从句用过去完成时。

exercises.q: If the committee ______ (approve) the proposal, the project will start next month.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时，主语 committee 视为单数。

exercises.q: Unless the government ______ (take) immediate action, the pollution will worsen.
exercises.explain: unless 引导条件从句，用一般现在时表示将来。

exercises.q: If you ______ (be) to succeed, you must be willing to work hard.
exercises.explain: be to do 结构表示将来，if 从句中用 are 保持现在时。

exercises.q: If the new policy will be implemented, it will affect thousands of workers.
exercises.explain: if 从句不能用将来时，应改为 If the new policy is implemented。

exercises.q: Were the government to raise taxes, many businesses would suffer.
exercises.explain: Were...to 是虚拟条件句的倒装形式，表示与将来事实相反的假设。

exercises.q: If you should have any questions, please feel free to contact me. (改为倒装句)
exercises.answer: Should you have any questions, please feel free to contact me.
exercises.explain: 省略 if 并将 should 提前，构成倒装条件句。

exercises.q: If the product doesn't meet your expectations, you can return it. (用 provided that 改写)
exercises.answer: Provided that the product doesn't meet your expectations, you can return it.
exercises.explain: provided that 可替代 if 引导条件从句，语气更正式。

exercises.q: If he had known the truth, he would have acted differently. (改为倒装句)
exercises.answer: Had he known the truth, he would have acted differently.
exercises.explain: 省略 if 并将 had 提前，构成虚拟条件句的倒装。

exercises.q: If the results will be positive, the team will proceed to the next phase.
exercises.answer: If the results are positive, the team will proceed to the next phase.
exercises.explain: if 条件从句用一般现在时，不能用 will be。

exercises.q: Unless you don't hurry, you will miss the deadline.
exercises.answer: Unless you hurry, you will miss the deadline.
exercises.explain: unless 本身已含否定意义，不能再加 don't。

grammar.title: 比较结构：形容词/副词比较级与修饰语（含 much / far / even / a little 及 that/those 替代）
grammar.titleEn: Comparative Structures: Comparative Adjectives/Adverbs, Modifiers, and Parallel Comparison
grammar.usage:
比较结构用于对两个人、事物、地点或动作在某一方面进行程度比较。核心结构是“比较级 + than”，例如 lower than、more expensive than、faster than。肯定句直接使用该结构；否定句在 be/助动词后加 not，或使用 less + 原级 + than 表示“不如……”；疑问句将 be/助动词提前，如 Is this phone cheaper than that one? 比较级前常加程度副词来细化差异，如 much、far、a lot、even、still 表示“得多/甚至更”，a little、a bit、slightly 表示“稍微”。

初中阶段主要要求掌握规则与不规则比较级变化，以及两者比较用比较级、三者及以上用最高级。高中阶段则更强调比较对象的一致性、书面语中的替代词 that/those、以及“the + 比较级, the + 比较级”等高级结构。例如，比较价格时常需要避免重复名词：The price here is lower than that in malls. 其中 that 指代 the price，复数用 those。

与近义结构对比：as...as 表示同级比较（not as/so...as 表示不如），而比较级 + than 表示差异比较。less + 原级 + than 是 more + 原级 + than 的反向表达，但语气更正式。最高级用于三者或以上，常与 in/of 短语连用。

易错点：1. 比较对象不对等，例如误写 The price here is lower than malls，应改为 than that in malls；2. 比较级前误用 very，应使用 much/far/a lot 等；3. 不规则形容词混淆，如 good-better-best、bad-worse-worst、many/much-more-most；4. 双音节词有时两种变化皆可，如 cleverer/more clever，但书面语倾向 more clever；5. 用 less 时不要再用比较级，如 less cheaper 是错误的。
forms: 比较级 + than + 比较对象：This phone is cheaper than that one.
much / far / a lot / even / still / a little / slightly + 比较级：The price is much lower here.
less + 原级 + than（表示“不如……”）：This brand is less popular than that one.
not as/so + 原级 + as（同级否定）：It is not as expensive as I expected.
the + 比较级, the + 比较级（越……越……）：The higher the price, the better the quality.
比较对象替代：that（单数/不可数）/ those（复数）：The price here is lower than that in malls.
notes: 比较对象必须对等：地点与地点比、价格与价格比，书面语中常用 that/those 替代前面出现过的名词，避免重复。
修饰比较级用 much、far、a lot、even、still、a little、slightly 等，不能用 very；very 只能修饰原级。
高考书面语中，less + 原级 + than 比 not as...as 更正式，但注意 less 后必须接原级，不可接比较级。
不规则比较级要熟记：good-better-best、bad-worse-worst、many/much-more-most、little-less-least、far-farther/further。
“the + 比较级, the + 比较级”结构中，前后都要用比较级，且主谓可部分省略，如 The sooner, the better.

examples.en: My schoolbag is heavier than yours.
examples.cn: 我的书包比你的重。

examples.en: This dress is much cheaper than the one in the shopping mall.
examples.cn: 这条连衣裙比购物中心里的那条便宜得多。

examples.en: He speaks English far more fluently than I do.
examples.cn: 他英语说得比我流利得多。

examples.en: The population of Shanghai is larger than that of Beijing.
examples.cn: 上海的人口比北京多。

examples.en: The more you practice, the more confident you will become.
examples.cn: 你练习得越多，就会变得越自信。

examples.en: This policy is less effective than the previous one in reducing costs.
examples.cn: 这项政策在降低成本方面不如前一项有效。

exercises.q: My bag is ______ than yours.
exercises.explain: 两者比较用比较级，heavy 的比较级是 heavier。

exercises.q: This book is ______ than that one.
exercises.explain: 多音节形容词比较级用 more 加原级。

exercises.q: Tom is ______ boy in our class.
exercises.explain: 三者以上比较用最高级，最高级前要加 the。

exercises.q: The weather today is much ______ than yesterday.
exercises.explain: good 的比较级是不规则的 better，much 修饰比较级表示程度。

exercises.q: Lucy runs ______ than Lily.
exercises.explain: fast 的比较级是 faster，两者比较用比较级。

exercises.q: This apple is ______ (small) than that one.
exercises.explain: 两者比较用比较级，small 加 -er。

exercises.q: My sister is two years ______ (old) than me.
exercises.explain: old 的比较级是 older，表示年龄更大。

exercises.q: The red dress is ______ (expensive) than the blue one.
exercises.explain: 多音节形容词比较级用 more 加原级。

exercises.q: This box is more heavier than that one.
exercises.explain: heavier 已经是比较级，不能再加 more。

exercises.q: My father is the tallest in my family.
exercises.explain: 家庭成员三人以上用最高级，tallest 前有 the。

exercises.q: This pen is longer than that pen. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: This pen is not longer than that pen.
exercises.explain: 否定句在 be 动词后加 not。

exercises.q: Tom is taller than Jack. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.explain: 一般疑问句将 be 动词提到句首。

exercises.q: This book is cheaper than that one. (用 expensive 改写，保持句意不变)
exercises.answer: That book is more expensive than this one.
exercises.explain: 换用反义词 expensive 时需交换比较对象。

exercises.q: My schoolbag is more big than yours.
exercises.answer: My schoolbag is bigger than yours.
exercises.explain: big 的比较级是 bigger，不能加 more。

exercises.q: She is the better student in our class.
exercises.answer: She is the best student in our class.
exercises.explain: 三者以上比较用最高级 best，不用比较级 better。

exercises.q: The price of this phone is much ______ than that one.
exercises.explain: low 的比较级是 lower，much 修饰比较级表示程度。

exercises.q: This question is ______ of the three.
exercises.explain: 三者比较用最高级，多音节词最高级前加 the most。

exercises.q: The weather in Kunming is much better than ______ in Beijing.
exercises.explain: 比较对象要对等，用 that 替代前面提到的 weather。

exercises.q: He is a little ______ than his brother.
exercises.explain: a little 修饰比较级 taller，表示程度轻微。

exercises.q: This film is even ______ than that one.
exercises.explain: even 修饰比较级，多音节词用 more 加原级。

exercises.q: The population of Shanghai is much ______ (large) than that of Suzhou.
exercises.explain: large 的比较级是 larger，much 修饰比较级。

exercises.q: This problem is ______ (easy) than the one we did yesterday.
exercises.explain: easy 的比较级是 easier，变 y 为 i 加 -er。

exercises.q: Among all the subjects, I like English ______ (well).
exercises.explain: 三者以上比较用最高级，well 的最高级是 best。

exercises.q: The price here is lower than that in malls.
exercises.explain: 用 that 替代 price，比较对象对等，结构正确。

exercises.q: This book is much more cheaper than that one.
exercises.explain: cheaper 已是比较级，不能再加 more。

exercises.q: This dress is more beautiful than that one. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: This dress is not more beautiful than that one.
exercises.explain: 否定句在 be 动词后加 not。

exercises.q: Tom runs faster than any other student in his class. (改为同义句)
exercises.answer: Tom runs the fastest in his class.
exercises.explain: 比较级加 any other 可转换为最高级表达。

exercises.q: This bag is 50 yuan. That bag is 80 yuan. (合并为一句，用 expensive)
exercises.answer: That bag is more expensive than this one.
exercises.explain: 价格更高对应 more expensive，注意比较对象顺序。

exercises.q: The weather in Hainan is warmer than Beijing.
exercises.answer: The weather in Hainan is warmer than that in Beijing.
exercises.explain: 比较对象要对等，用 that 替代 the weather。

exercises.q: She is the most tallest girl in her class.
exercises.answer: She is the tallest girl in her class.
exercises.explain: tallest 已是最高级，不能再加 most。

exercises.q: The more you practice, ______ you will become.
exercises.explain: the + 比较级，the + 比较级 表示越……越……。

exercises.q: This luxury bag is sold at a much lower price on overseas apps than ______ in shopping malls.
exercises.explain: 用 that 替代前面的 price，保持比较对象对等。

exercises.q: He is ______ of the two brothers.
exercises.explain: 两者中较……的一个用 the + 比较级。

exercises.q: The situation is far ______ than we expected.
exercises.explain: bad 的比较级是不规则的 worse，far 修饰比较级。

exercises.q: No other student in the class is ______ than Mary.
exercises.explain: 否定词加比较级表示最高级含义，多音节词用 more。

exercises.q: The ______ (careful) you are, the fewer mistakes you will make.
exercises.explain: the + 比较级，the + 比较级 结构，careful 用 more careful。

exercises.q: This problem is by far ______ (difficult) one I have ever met.
exercises.explain: by far 常与最高级连用，多音节词最高级用 the most。

exercises.q: The number of cars in this city is twice ______ (many) as that in that city.
exercises.explain: 倍数表达用 as + 原级 + as 结构。

exercises.q: The price of this coat is twice higher than that one.
exercises.explain: 倍数表达应为 twice as high as，不能用 twice higher than。

exercises.q: The more books you read, the more knowledge you will get.
exercises.explain: the + 比较级，the + 比较级 结构使用正确。

exercises.q: This watch is less expensive than that one. (用 cheaper 改写，保持句意不变)
exercises.answer: This watch is cheaper than that one.
exercises.explain: less expensive 等同于 cheaper，注意比较对象不变。

exercises.q: He is the best student in his class. (用 better 改写，保持句意不变)
exercises.answer: He is better than any other student in his class.
exercises.explain: 最高级可转换为比较级加 any other 结构。

exercises.q: The price on overseas apps is much lower than that in malls. (改为感叹句，用 how)
exercises.answer: How much lower the price on overseas apps is than that in malls!
exercises.explain: 感叹句用 how 加形容词比较级，注意语序调整。

exercises.q: The more he eats, the fatter he gets, and the more he wants to eat.
exercises.answer: The more he eats, the fatter he gets, and the more he wants to eat.
exercises.explain: 此句结构正确，无需修改，考查 the more...the more 结构的辨识。

exercises.q: This is the most unique opportunity I have ever had.
exercises.answer: This is the most unusual opportunity I have ever had.
exercises.explain: unique 本身表示独一无二，不能用比较级或最高级，应换用 unusual。

exercises.q: The weather today is much ______ than yesterday.
exercises.explain: much 修饰比较级，cold 的比较级是 colder。

exercises.q: My bag is heavier than ______.
exercises.explain: 比较对象要对等，yours 指代 your bag。

exercises.q: This book is ______ than that one.
exercises.explain: 多音节形容词比较级用 more 构成。

exercises.q: Tom runs ______ than any other student in his class.
exercises.explain: than 提示用比较级，any other 表示与班级其他学生逐一比较。

exercises.q: The price of this phone is a little ______ than that one.
exercises.explain: a little 修饰比较级，high 的比较级是 higher。

exercises.q: This dress is ______ (cheap) than the one in the mall.
exercises.explain: than 提示用比较级，cheap 的比较级是 cheaper。

exercises.q: The red car is much ______ (expensive) than the blue one.
exercises.explain: 多音节形容词比较级用 more，much 修饰比较级。

exercises.q: Her hair is ______ (long) than mine.
exercises.explain: than 提示用比较级，long 的比较级是 longer。

exercises.q: The sentence "This box is more heavier than that one" is correct.
exercises.explain: heavier 已经是比较级，不能再加 more。

exercises.q: The sentence "My sister is taller than me" is correct.
exercises.explain: taller than 是比较级结构，比较对象对等。

exercises.q: This shirt is cheaper than that one. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: This shirt is not cheaper than that one.
exercises.explain: 在 is 后加 not 构成否定句。

exercises.q: The apple is bigger than the orange. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Is the apple bigger than the orange?
exercises.explain: 将 be 动词 is 提到句首构成一般疑问句。

exercises.q: This room is larger than that room. (用 that 替代 that room 改写)
exercises.answer: This room is larger than that.
exercises.explain: 用 that 替代重复的名词，使比较对象简洁。

exercises.q: This pen is more cheaper than that one.
exercises.answer: This pen is cheaper than that one.
exercises.explain: cheaper 已是比较级，去掉 more。

exercises.q: The weather in Beijing is colder than Shanghai.
exercises.answer: The weather in Beijing is colder than that in Shanghai.
exercises.explain: 比较对象要对等，用 that 指代 the weather。

exercises.q: The new model is far ______ than the old one.
exercises.explain: far 修饰比较级，多音节形容词用 more 构成比较级。

exercises.q: The population of Shanghai is larger than ______ of Nanjing.
exercises.explain: 用 that 指代不可数名词 population，保持比较对象对等。

exercises.q: She speaks English ______ than her brother.
exercises.explain: 修饰动词 speaks 需用副词比较级 more fluently。

exercises.q: The situation is getting ______ worse.
exercises.explain: even 可以修饰比较级 worse，表示程度加深。

exercises.q: This task is ______ more difficult than I expected.
exercises.explain: a lot 修饰比较级 more difficult，表示程度大。

exercises.q: The air quality in the countryside is much ______ (good) than that in the city.
exercises.explain: good 的比较级是不规则变化 better。

exercises.q: He did ______ (bad) in the exam than his deskmate.
exercises.explain: bad 的比较级是不规则变化 worse。

exercises.q: The more you practice, the ______ (good) you will become.
exercises.explain: the more...the better 是固定比较结构。

exercises.q: The sentence "This problem is less easier than that one" is correct.
exercises.explain: less 后接原级，应改为 less easy 或 not easier。

exercises.q: The sentence "The more you read, the more you know" is correct.
exercises.explain: the more...the more 结构表示"越……越……"。

exercises.q: This laptop is not as expensive as that one. (用 than 改写，保持句意)
exercises.answer: This laptop is less expensive than that one.
exercises.explain: not as...as 可转换为 less...than 结构。

exercises.q: He can run faster than me. (用 be able to 改写)
exercises.answer: He is able to run faster than me.
exercises.explain: can 与 be able to 可互换，注意人称和时态。

exercises.q: The film was more interesting than the book. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: The film was not more interesting than the book.
exercises.explain: 在 was 后加 not 构成否定句。

exercises.q: The number of students in our school is more than their school.
exercises.answer: The number of students in our school is larger than that in their school.
exercises.explain: number 用 large/small 修饰，且比较对象需用 that 指代。

exercises.q: She is more kinder than her sister.
exercises.answer: She is kinder than her sister.
exercises.explain: kinder 已是比较级，不能再加 more。

exercises.q: The impact of the new policy on small businesses is ______ than previously estimated.
exercises.explain: 复合形容词比较级用 more 构成，than 提示比较级。

exercises.q: No sooner had he arrived ______ he was asked to leave.
exercises.explain: no sooner...than 是固定搭配，表示"一……就……"。

exercises.q: The more complex the problem is, ______ patience is required.
exercises.explain: the more...the more 结构表示"越……越……"。

exercises.explain: little 的比较级是 less，修饰 convincing。

exercises.q: The ______ (far) we walked, the more tired we became.
exercises.explain: the more...the more 结构，far 的比较级用 farther。

exercises.q: The sentence "The more he tried, the worse the situation became" is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: the more...the worse 结构正确，表示"越……越……"。

exercises.explain: preferable 本身已含比较含义，不与 more 连用。

exercises.q: The new bridge is three times as long as the old one. (用 than 改写)
exercises.answer: The new bridge is three times longer than the old one.
exercises.explain: 倍数表达 as...as 可转换为比较级 than 结构。

exercises.explain: 最高级可转换为比较级加 any other 结构。

exercises.q: The more you practice, the better your performance will be. (改为一般疑问句)

exercises.explain: 将 will 提前构成疑问句，保持 the more...the better 结构。

exercises.explain: higher 已是比较级，去掉 more，并用 that 指代 quality。

exercises.answer: She is one of the most brilliant scientists of her generation.
exercises.explain: one of 后接复数名词 scientists。

grammar.key: Infinitive of Purpose / 目的不定式
grammar.title: 目的不定式：to do / in order to / so as to / so that 的用法与拓展
grammar.titleEn: Infinitive of Purpose: to do, in order to, so as to, and so that
grammar.usage:
目的不定式（Infinitive of Purpose）的核心结构是“to + 动词原形”，用来解释某个动作发生的目的，相当于中文的“为了……”。它通常放在句末，回答“为什么做这件事”的问题。例如：We make appointments to save time.（我们预约是为了节省时间。）

肯定形式直接用“to + 动词原形”；否定形式不能直接在 to 前加 not，而要用“in order not to + 动词原形”或“so as not to + 动词原形”。例如：She left quietly in order not to wake the baby.（她悄悄离开，为了不吵醒婴儿。）疑问句中，目的不定式本身不参与疑问结构的变化，疑问词仍放在句首，如：Why did you go out early? — To catch the first bus.（你为什么早早出门？——为了赶首班车。）

与近义结构对比时需要注意：“to do”最简洁、最常用；“in order to do”更正式，可置于句首或句末，强调目的性；“so as to do”通常只放在句末，不用于句首；“so that + 从句”则引导目的状语从句，常与情态动词 can/could/may/might 连用，语气更完整。例如：He saved money so that he could buy a new phone.（他存钱是为了能买一部新手机。）

初中阶段主要掌握“to + 动词原形”表示目的，能识别句末目的状语，并会区分“to do”与“for + 名词/动名词”的差别。高中阶段则要求进一步掌握 in order to、so as to、so that 的转换与语域差异，理解目的状语与结果状语的区别，并能在书面表达中根据正式程度灵活选用结构。

易错点一：把目的不定式与作宾语的不定式混淆。例如 I want to go home 中的 to go home 是宾语，不是目的状语；而 I went home to get my keys 中的 to get my keys 才是目的。易错点二：否定形式误写成 don't to do 或 to not do，正确应为 in order not to do / so as not to do。易错点三：so as to 不可放在句首，句首只能用 to 或 in order to。易错点四：so that 引导目的从句时，从句中通常要有 can/could/may/might 等情态动词，否则可能被理解为结果状语。
forms: 主语 + 谓语 + to + 动词原形（目的）
主语 + 谓语 + in order to + 动词原形（目的，可置于句首或句末）
主语 + 谓语 + so as to + 动词原形（目的，只置于句末）
主语 + 谓语 + in order not to / so as not to + 动词原形（否定目的）
主语 + 谓语 + so that + 主语 + can/could/may/might + 动词原形（目的从句）
To + 动词原形 + 目的, 主语 + 谓语（句首强调目的）
notes: 高考书面表达中，句首表示目的时用 To do 或 In order to do，不能用 So as to do，因为 so as to 不能位于句首。
否定目的要用 in order not to do 或 so as not to do，不要写成 to not do 或 don't to do，这在高中语法填空和改错中常考。
so that 引导目的状语从句时，从句中通常需要 can/could/may/might 等情态动词；如果从句中没有情态动词，可能被理解为结果状语，语义会发生变化。
在正式语域中，in order to 比 to do 更显正式，适合用于说明文、议论文等书面表达；口语和日常交流中多用 to do。
注意区分 to do 作目的状语与作宾语、定语或主语补足语的情况。判断方法是：目的状语可以回答“为什么”的问题，且常可替换为 in order to do。

examples.en: I study hard to get good grades.
examples.cn: 我努力学习是为了取得好成绩。

examples.en: She went to the library to borrow some books.
examples.cn: 她去图书馆借一些书。

examples.en: He spoke slowly in order to make himself understood.
examples.cn: 他说得很慢，为了让别人听懂他的意思。

examples.en: We left early so as not to miss the last train.
examples.cn: 我们早早离开，以免错过末班火车。

examples.en: To improve her spoken English, she practices with native speakers every weekend.
examples.cn: 为了提高英语口语，她每个周末都和母语者练习。

examples.en: The company introduced a flexible working policy so that employees could better balance work and family life.
examples.cn: 公司推出弹性工作政策，以便员工能更好地平衡工作与家庭生活。

exercises.q: She opened the window ______ some fresh air.
exercises.explain: 用不定式 to get 表示开窗的目的。

exercises.q: I went to the library ______ a book.
exercises.explain: to borrow 表示去图书馆的目的。

exercises.q: He turned on the light ______ better.
exercises.explain: to see 表示开灯是为了看得更清楚。

exercises.q: They are saving money ______ a new bike.
exercises.explain: to buy 表示存钱的目的是买新自行车。

exercises.q: We use a knife ______ things.
exercises.explain: to cut 表示刀的用途是切东西。

exercises.q: She is running fast ______ catch the bus.
exercises.explain: to catch 表示跑得快是为了赶上公交车。

exercises.q: He went to the shop ______ buy some milk.
exercises.explain: to buy 表示去商店的目的是买牛奶。

exercises.q: I called my friend ______ say sorry.
exercises.explain: to say 表示打电话是为了道歉。

exercises.q: She went to the park to play football. The phrase 'to play football' tells us why she went to the park.
exercises.explain: to play football 是目的状语，说明去公园的原因。

exercises.q: He opened the door to. The sentence is correct.
exercises.explain: to 后面必须接动词原形，不能单独使用。

exercises.q: She went to the kitchen. She wanted to get some water. (用 to 合并句子)
exercises.answer: She went to the kitchen to get some water.
exercises.explain: 用不定式 to get 合并两个句子表示目的。

exercises.q: He is studying hard because he wants to pass the exam. (用 to 改写)
exercises.answer: He is studying hard to pass the exam.
exercises.explain: 将 because he wants to pass 改写为不定式 to pass 表目的。

exercises.q: I went to the shop. I wanted to buy a pen. (用 to 合并句子)
exercises.answer: I went to the shop to buy a pen.
exercises.explain: 用 to buy 合并句子表示去商店的目的。

exercises.q: She went to the library for borrow a book.
exercises.answer: She went to the library to borrow a book.
exercises.explain: 表示目的应用 to borrow，不用 for borrow。

exercises.q: He opened the window to getting some air.
exercises.answer: He opened the window to get some air.
exercises.explain: to 后面必须接动词原形 get，不能接 getting。

exercises.q: She got up early ______ the first train.
exercises.explain: to catch 表示早起是为了赶上第一班火车。

exercises.q: He turned off the TV ______ his homework quietly.
exercises.explain: to do 表示关电视是为了安静地做作业。

exercises.q: They went to the hospital ______ their sick friend.
exercises.explain: to visit 表示去医院是为了看望生病的朋友。

exercises.q: We should eat healthy food ______ strong.
exercises.explain: to stay 表示吃健康食品是为了保持强壮。

exercises.q: She took a taxi ______ late for the meeting.
exercises.explain: 否定目的用 not to be，表示为了不迟到。

exercises.q: He is practicing every day ______ improve his English.
exercises.explain: to improve 表示每天练习是为了提高英语。

exercises.q: She left early ______ avoid the traffic.
exercises.explain: to avoid 表示早离开是为了避开交通拥堵。

exercises.q: They are working hard ______ finish the project on time.
exercises.explain: to finish 表示努力工作是为了按时完成项目。

exercises.q: He went to the gym to keep fit. The phrase 'to keep fit' answers the question 'why'.
exercises.explain: to keep fit 是目的状语，回答为什么去健身房。

exercises.q: She bought a dictionary to looking up new words. The sentence is correct.
exercises.explain: to 后应接动词原形 look，不能接 looking。

exercises.q: He went to the station early. He wanted to get a good seat. (用 in order to 改写)
exercises.answer: He went to the station early in order to get a good seat.
exercises.explain: in order to 与 to 一样可以表示目的，语气更正式。

exercises.q: She is saving money because she wants to buy a new phone. (用 to 改写)
exercises.answer: She is saving money to buy a new phone.
exercises.explain: 将 because 从句改写为不定式 to buy 表目的。

exercises.q: They went to the beach. They wanted to swim. (用 to 合并句子)
exercises.answer: They went to the beach to swim.
exercises.explain: 用 to swim 合并句子表示去海滩的目的。

exercises.q: He is studying hard for pass the exam.
exercises.answer: He is studying hard to pass the exam.
exercises.explain: 表示目的应用 to pass，不能用 for pass。

exercises.q: She went to the shop to buying some bread.
exercises.answer: She went to the shop to buy some bread.
exercises.explain: to 后应接动词原形 buy，不能接 buying。

exercises.q: ______ more about the world, she reads newspapers every day.
exercises.explain: 句首用 To learn 强调目的，表示为了了解更多世界。

exercises.q: He spoke slowly ______ everyone could understand him.
exercises.explain: so that 后接从句，表示以便每个人都能理解他。

exercises.q: She left home early ______ miss the bus.
exercises.explain: 否定目的用 in order not to，表示为了不错过公交车。

exercises.q: The teacher gave us more examples ______ us understand the rule better.
exercises.explain: to help 表示老师给更多例子是为了帮助我们更好理解规则。

exercises.q: He went to the bookstore ______ a new novel, but he bought a magazine instead.
exercises.explain: to buy 表示去书店的目的是买新小说。

exercises.q: She took a part-time job ______ earn some extra money.
exercises.explain: to earn 表示做兼职是为了赚额外收入。

exercises.q: He wrote down the address ______ not forget it.
exercises.explain: so as not to 是 in order not to 的另一种表达，表示为了不忘记。

exercises.q: ______ get a better view, they climbed to the top of the hill.
exercises.explain: 句首用 To 引导目的状语，表示为了获得更好的视野。

exercises.q: She went to the library to borrow some books. The phrase 'to borrow some books' is an adverbial of purpose.
exercises.explain: to borrow some books 是目的状语，说明去图书馆的目的。

exercises.q: He got up early so that he could catch the first train. The clause 'so that he could catch the first train' expresses purpose.
exercises.explain: so that 引导的从句在此表示目的，意为以便能赶上第一班火车。

exercises.q: She went to the gym because she wanted to lose weight. (用 in order to 改写)
exercises.answer: She went to the gym in order to lose weight.
exercises.explain: 将 because 从句改写为 in order to 短语表目的。

exercises.q: He spoke louder so that everyone could hear him. (用 to 改写)
exercises.answer: He spoke louder to let everyone hear him.
exercises.explain: 将 so that 从句改写为 to let 不定式表目的。

exercises.q: They are working hard. They want to finish the project before Friday. (用 so as to 合并)
exercises.answer: They are working hard so as to finish the project before Friday.
exercises.explain: so as to 与 in order to 一样表示目的，用于合并句子。

exercises.q: She went to the station early so that she not miss the train.
exercises.answer: She went to the station early so that she would not miss the train.
exercises.explain: so that 从句中需用完整谓语，应改为 would not miss。

exercises.q: He is saving money for buy a new computer.
exercises.answer: He is saving money to buy a new computer.
exercises.explain: 表示目的应用 to buy，不能用 for buy。

exercises.q: She went to the library ______ some books for her project.
exercises.explain: 不定式 to borrow 表示去图书馆的目的，符合“目的不定式”结构。

exercises.q: We should eat more vegetables ______ healthy.
exercises.explain: to stay 表示吃蔬菜的目的，是典型的目的状语。

exercises.q: He turned on the light ______ better.
exercises.explain: to see 解释开灯的原因，作目的状语。

exercises.q: They left early ______ the last bus.
exercises.explain: to catch 表示早走的目的，不定式作状语。

exercises.q: I need a pen ______ this form.
exercises.explain: to fill out 说明需要笔的目的，不定式作目的状语。

exercises.q: She opened the window ______ get some fresh air.
exercises.explain: 不定式符号 to 后接动词原形，表示打开窗户的目的。

exercises.q: He is saving money ______ buy a new bike.
exercises.explain: to buy 表示存钱的目的，构成目的不定式。

exercises.q: We went to the station ______ meet our uncle.
exercises.explain: to meet 说明去车站的目的，不定式作状语。

exercises.q: The sentence "She studies hard to get good grades." means she studies hard because she wants to get good grades.
exercises.explain: 不定式 to get good grades 表示努力学习的目的，释义正确。

exercises.q: In the sentence "He went to the shop for buying milk.", the phrase "for buying" is the correct way to show purpose.
exercises.explain: 表示目的应用 to buy，for buying 是错误搭配。

exercises.q: She went to the kitchen. She wanted to cook dinner. (用 to 合并句子)
exercises.answer: She went to the kitchen to cook dinner.
exercises.explain: 用不定式 to cook dinner 合并，表示去厨房的目的。

exercises.q: He is practicing every day. He wants to win the match. (用 to 合并句子)
exercises.answer: He is practicing every day to win the match.
exercises.explain: to win the match 表示每天练习的目的。

exercises.q: I went to the store. I wanted to buy some bread. (用 to 合并句子)
exercises.answer: I went to the store to buy some bread.
exercises.explain: 不定式 to buy some bread 表示去商店的目的。

exercises.q: She went to the park for to walk her dog.
exercises.answer: She went to the park to walk her dog.
exercises.explain: 表示目的直接用 to walk，for to 是错误结构。

exercises.q: He studies hard for pass the exam.
exercises.answer: He studies hard to pass the exam.
exercises.explain: 目的状语应用不定式 to pass，而非 for pass。

exercises.q: She took a part-time job ______ enough money for her tuition.
exercises.explain: to earn 表示做兼职的目的，不定式作目的状语。

exercises.q: ______ the early train, they set off before dawn.
exercises.explain: 句首不定式 To catch 强调目的，表示为了赶上早班火车。

exercises.q: He wrote down the address ______ forget it.
exercises.explain: so as not to 是否定目的状语，表示“为了不忘记”。

exercises.q: The company hired more workers ______ the production speed.
exercises.explain: to increase 表示雇佣更多工人的目的。

exercises.q: She turned off her phone ______ interrupted during the meeting.
exercises.explain: in order not to be 是否定目的状语，表示“为了不被干扰”。

exercises.q: He left home early ______ avoid the heavy traffic.
exercises.explain: to avoid 表示早出门的目的，不定式作目的状语。

exercises.q: They spoke in low voices ______ not wake the baby.
exercises.explain: so as not to 是目的否定的固定结构，表示“为了不吵醒婴儿”。

exercises.q: She joined the club ______ make new friends.
exercises.explain: to make 表示加入俱乐部的目的。

exercises.q: The sentence "To improve his health, he started jogging every morning." has the infinitive of purpose at the beginning for emphasis.
exercises.explain: 句首不定式 To improve his health 强调目的，符合目的状语用法。

exercises.q: In the sentence "He went to the gym for getting fit.", the phrase "for getting" is an acceptable way to express purpose.
exercises.explain: 表示目的应用 to get fit，for getting 不是标准目的表达。

exercises.q: She saved her pocket money. She wanted to buy a gift for her mother. (用 in order to 改写)
exercises.answer: She saved her pocket money in order to buy a gift for her mother.
exercises.explain: in order to 引导目的状语，比 to 更正式，表示“为了”。

exercises.q: He wore a thick coat. He didn't want to feel cold. (用 so as not to 改写)
exercises.answer: He wore a thick coat so as not to feel cold.
exercises.explain: so as not to 表示否定目的，意为“为了不感到冷”。

exercises.q: They are working overtime. They want to finish the project on time. (用 to 改写)
exercises.answer: They are working overtime to finish the project on time.
exercises.explain: to finish 表示加班的目的，不定式作目的状语。

exercises.q: She went to the bookstore for buying a dictionary.
exercises.answer: She went to the bookstore to buy a dictionary.
exercises.explain: 表示目的应用 to buy，for buying 是错误搭配。

exercises.q: He studies hard for not fail the final exam.
exercises.answer: He studies hard in order not to fail the final exam.
exercises.explain: 否定目的应用 in order not to，for not fail 结构错误。

exercises.q: ______ a more accurate diagnosis, the doctor recommended several additional tests.
exercises.explain: 句首不定式 To obtain 表示目的，强调为了获得更准确的诊断。

exercises.q: The committee revised the proposal ______ any potential misunderstandings among stakeholders.
exercises.explain: so as to avoid 表示目的，意为“为了避免任何潜在误解”。

exercises.q: He enrolled in an advanced language course ______ his fluency before applying for the overseas position.
exercises.explain: to enhance 表示报名课程的目的，不定式作目的状语。

exercises.q: ______ the risk of data loss, the system automatically backs up all files every hour.
exercises.explain: 句首 To minimize 强调目的，表示为了降低数据丢失风险。

exercises.q: The researcher conducted multiple trials ______ the reliability of the experimental results.
exercises.explain: in order to verify 表示进行多次试验的目的，结构正式且准确。

exercises.q: The government launched a new campaign ______ raise public awareness of environmental protection.
exercises.explain: to raise 表示发起运动的目的，不定式作目的状语。

exercises.q: She adjusted the microscope carefully ______ not damage the specimen.
exercises.explain: so as not to 是否定目的状语，表示“为了不损坏样本”。

exercises.q: The architect designed the building with large windows ______ maximize natural light.
exercises.explain: to maximize 表示设计大窗户的目的。

exercises.q: In the sentence "To fully understand the phenomenon, one must consider its historical context.", the infinitive phrase functions as an adverbial of purpose.
exercises.explain: 句首不定式 To fully understand 表示目的，作目的状语。

exercises.q: The phrase "for reducing costs" in "The company adopted new software for reducing costs." is the most formal and precise way to express purpose.
exercises.explain: 表示目的更常用 to reduce 或 in order to reduce，for reducing 不是最正式的表达。

exercises.q: The university established a new scholarship program. It wanted to attract outstanding international students. (用 in order to 改写)
exercises.answer: The university established a new scholarship program in order to attract outstanding international students.
exercises.explain: in order to 引导目的状语，表示设立奖学金项目的意图。

exercises.q: He took detailed notes during the lecture. He didn't want to miss any important points. (用 so as not to 改写)
exercises.answer: He took detailed notes during the lecture so as not to miss any important points.
exercises.explain: so as not to 表示否定目的，意为“为了不遗漏任何要点”。

exercises.q: The company implemented a new training system. It wanted to improve employee productivity. (用 to 改写)

grammar.key: Present Perfect Tense / 现在完成时
grammar.title: 现在完成时：从“已经发生”到“持续影响”（含与一般过去时、现在完成进行时辨析）
grammar.titleEn: Present Perfect Tense: From Completion to Current Relevance
grammar.usage:
现在完成时的核心结构为“主语 + have/has + 过去分词”，用来连接过去与现在。它主要有两种功能：一是表示过去发生的动作对现在造成的影响或结果，常译为“已经……了”；二是表示从过去某一时间开始一直持续到现在的动作或状态，常与 for + 时间段、since + 时间点连用。
肯定句用 have/has + done；否定句在 have/has 后加 not，可缩写为 haven't / hasn't；疑问句把 have/has 提到主语之前。例如：Have you seen this video? — Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.
与一般过去时对比：一般过去时只说明动作发生在过去某个具体时间，与现在无关；现在完成时则强调过去动作与现在的联系。例如：I saw the film yesterday.（只说明昨天看了）与 I have seen the film.（强调现在知道内容或不想再看）。
与现在完成进行时对比：现在完成进行时（have/has been doing）更强调动作本身一直在持续、可能还未结束；现在完成时更强调结果或完成状态。例如：I have read the book.（已经读完）与 I have been reading the book.（一直在读，可能还没读完）。
初中阶段主要掌握 already、yet、ever、never、just、before、recently 等标志词，以及 for/since 的简单用法。高中阶段需要进一步理解：现在完成时在新闻、评论、学术写作中用于引出具有现实意义的事实；在时间/条件状语从句中可表示将来完成；还需注意瞬间动词（如 buy、borrow、leave、die）在表示持续状态时要转换为延续性表达（如 have had、have kept、have been away、have been dead）。
易错点一：把瞬间动词直接与 for + 时间段连用，如“He has bought the car for two years”是错误的，应改为“He has had the car for two years”。易错点二：在明确的过去时间状语（yesterday、last week、in 2019、two days ago）出现时误用现在完成时，应改用一般过去时。易错点三：have/has been to（去过某地已回来）与 have/has gone to（去了某地还没回来）混淆。易错点四：在书面表达中过度使用现在完成时，忽略一般过去时对过去事实的客观陈述功能，导致语篇时态单一。
forms: 肯定句：主语 + have/has + 过去分词
否定句：主语 + have/has + not + 过去分词（haven't / hasn't）
一般疑问句：Have/Has + 主语 + 过去分词 + ...?
特殊疑问句：疑问词 + have/has + 主语 + 过去分词 + ...?
与 since 连用：since + 时间点 / 一般过去时从句
与 for 连用：for + 时间段（需用延续性动词或状态表达）
notes: 高考书面表达中，现在完成时常用于开头引入背景或总结影响，如“In recent years, short videos have gained widespread popularity.”，比一般过去时更具现实关联感。
在新闻报道和评论类语篇中，现在完成时与一般过去时经常交替出现：现在完成时引出事件及其当前影响，一般过去时补充具体过去时间、地点和细节。
注意瞬间动词与延续性表达的转换：buy→have had, borrow→have kept, leave→have been away, die→have been dead, begin→have been on。
在正式语域中，have/has got 表示“拥有”时与 have/has 意义相近，但 have/has got 更偏口语，高考书面表达中建议使用 have/has。
since 从句中用一般过去时，主句用现在完成时，这是高考语法填空和短文改错的高频考点。

exercises.q: I ______ my homework already.
exercises.explain: already 常与现在完成时连用，表示已经完成。

exercises.q: She ______ never ______ to Beijing.
exercises.explain: 主语 She 用 has，have been to 表示去过某地。

exercises.q: They ______ the film twice this week.
exercises.explain: this week 表示从过去到现在的这段时间，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: My brother ______ his key. He can't open the door.
exercises.explain: 丢钥匙的动作发生在过去，对现在造成影响——开不了门。

exercises.q: ______ you ______ your new teacher yet?
exercises.explain: yet 用于现在完成时疑问句，表示已经见过吗。

exercises.q: We ______ (live) here since 2018.
exercises.explain: since + 时间点常与现在完成时连用。

exercises.q: He ______ (not finish) his lunch yet.
exercises.explain: yet 用于否定句，主语 He 用 has。

exercises.q: I ______ (read) this book before.
exercises.explain: before 表示以前，常与现在完成时连用。

exercises.q: She has went to the library.
exercises.explain: go 的过去分词是 gone，不是 went。

exercises.q: They have already cleaned the classroom.
exercises.explain: have + 过去分词 cleaned 结构正确。

exercises.q: I have seen that movie. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: I have not seen that movie.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时否定在 have/has 后加 not。

exercises.q: She has finished her work. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.explain: 现在完成时疑问句把 has 提到主语前。

exercises.q: He can swim. (用 be able to 改写)
exercises.explain: can 表示能力时可与 be able to 互换。

exercises.q: I have finish my breakfast.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时中动词要用过去分词 finished。

exercises.q: She have lost her pencil.
exercises.explain: 主语 She 是第三人称单数，要用 has。

exercises.q: He ______ in this school for three years.
exercises.explain: for + 时间段表示动作持续到现在，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: I ______ my pen. Can I use yours?
exercises.explain: 丢笔的动作发生在过去，对现在造成影响——需要借笔。

exercises.q: She ______ to the store. She will be back soon.
exercises.explain: has gone to 表示去了某地还没回来。

exercises.q: We ______ each other since we were children.
exercises.explain: since 引导时间状语从句，主句用现在完成时。

exercises.q: ______ you ever ______ to Shanghai?
exercises.explain: ever 常与现在完成时连用，have been to 表示去过某地。

exercises.q: They ______ (not see) each other for a long time.
exercises.explain: for a long time 表示持续到现在，用现在完成时否定。

exercises.q: My father ______ (work) in this company since 2015.
exercises.explain: since + 时间点与现在完成时连用，主语是第三人称单数。

exercises.q: I ______ (just finish) my homework.
exercises.explain: just 表示刚刚，常与现在完成时连用。

exercises.explain: last year 是过去时间点，不能与现在完成时连用。

exercises.q: I have known her for five years.
exercises.explain: for + 时间段表示持续到现在，用现在完成时正确。

exercises.q: They have visited the museum. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: They have not visited the museum.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时否定在 have 后加 not。

exercises.q: He has already finished his project. (改为一般疑问句)

exercises.q: I have bought this book two days ago.
exercises.answer: I bought this book two days ago.
exercises.explain: ago 表示过去时间点，要用一般过去时。

exercises.q: She has never went to Japan.

exercises.explain: go 的过去分词是 gone，但 have been to 表示去过某地。

exercises.q: By the time we arrived, the film ______ already ______.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导过去时间，用过去完成时表示动作先发生。

exercises.explain: has gone to 表示去了某地还没回来。

exercises.explain: 丢钥匙对现在造成影响——找不到，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: He ______ in this city since he was born.
exercises.explain: since 引导时间状语从句，主句用现在完成时。

exercises.explain: It is the first time that 后用现在完成时。

exercises.explain: since 引导时间状语从句，主句用现在完成时否定。

exercises.explain: has been to 表示去过已回来，与 still there 矛盾。

exercises.explain: before he moved away 表示过去时间，应用过去完成时。

exercises.explain: never 表示否定，反意疑问句用肯定形式。

exercises.q: They have lived here for ten years. (对 for ten years 提问)
exercises.answer: How long have they lived here?
exercises.explain: 对时间段提问用 how long。

exercises.explain: might 比 may 语气更不确定。

exercises.q: I have seen him yesterday.
exercises.explain: yesterday 是过去时间点，要用一般过去时。

exercises.explain: 表示去了还没回来应用 has gone to。

exercises.q: She ______ the film three times already.

exercises.explain: since + 时间点表示从过去持续到现在的状态，用现在完成时。

exercises.explain: 丢钥匙的动作发生在过去，对现在的影响是打不开门，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: We ______ each other since primary school.

exercises.q: She ______ (be) a teacher for five years.
exercises.explain: for + 时间段表示状态持续，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: The sentence "I have visited Beijing last year" is correct.

exercises.q: The sentence "She has just arrived home" is correct.

exercises.explain: No sooner 置于句首时，主句需部分倒装。

exercises.answer: By the time we got to the station, the train had already left.
exercises.explain: 火车离开发生在 got to 之前，应用过去完成时。

exercises.explain: since 后接时间点，for 后接时间段，three hours 是时间段应用 for。

grammar.key: Infinitive of Purpose / 动词不定式表目的
grammar.title: 动词不定式表目的：to do / in order to / so as to 的用法与拓展
grammar.titleEn: Infinitive of Purpose: to do / in order to / so as to
grammar.usage:
动词不定式表目的，是英语中说明“为什么做某事”的核心结构。其基本形式为“to + 动词原形”，放在主句之后，表示前面动作的目的或意图，中文常译为“为了……”“以便……”“来……”。例如：He got up early to catch the first bus.（他早起是为了赶第一班车。）

肯定句直接使用“主句 + to do”；否定形式在 to 前加 not，即“主句 + not to do”，也可用“in order not to do”或“so as not to do”，但注意 so as to 的否定不能单独用 not so as to do。疑问句通常借助主句的助动词构成，不定式部分保持原形，例如：Did you come here to see me?（你来这里是为了见我吗？）

与近义结构对比：in order to 和 so as to 比单纯的 to do 更正式、目的感更强，常用于书面语或强调目的时。in order to 可置于句首或句中，so as to 通常只置于句中，不放在句首。for + 名词/动名词也可表示目的，但侧重“用途、功能或原因”，如 a knife for cutting bread（切面包用的刀），而 to do 侧重“行为意图”。

初中阶段主要掌握“to do”表目的的基本用法，能识别并翻译“为了……”即可。高中阶段则需进一步掌握 in order to / so as to 的语域差异、否定形式、句首位置，以及不定式表目的与表结果（如 only to do、too...to...、enough to...）的区别，并能在书面表达中灵活替换，避免句式单一。

易错点：一是不定式表目的与动名词表目的混淆，英语中一般不用“for + doing”表示具体行为目的，如不说 I came here for learning English，应说 I came here to learn English。二是目的状语与结果状语混淆，only to do 常表意外结果而非目的，如 He hurried to the station only to find the train had left. 三是 so as to 不能置于句首，不能说 So as to pass the exam, he studied hard，应改为 In order to pass the exam, he studied hard。四是否定形式位置错误，不能说 I left early to not miss the train，应说 I left early not to miss the train 或 in order not to miss the train。
forms: 主句 + to + 动词原形（表目的）
主句 + in order to + 动词原形（更正式，可置句首）
主句 + so as to + 动词原形（更正式，不置句首）
主句 + not to / in order not to / so as not to + 动词原形（否定目的）
In order to + 动词原形 + 主句（目的前置，强调目的）
notes: 高考书面表达中，避免通篇只用 to do 表目的，可交替使用 in order to / so as to 提升句式多样性。
so as to 不能放在句首，这是高中语法填空和改错中的高频设错点。
不定式表目的与表结果要区分：only to do 常表“出乎意料的结果”，不是目的，高考完形和阅读中常考。
否定目的时，not 要放在 to 前面，如 not to do，而不是 to not do；书面语中更推荐 in order not to do。
for + 动名词可表用途，但不用于具体行为目的，高中写作中避免 I did sth. for doing sth. 的错误表达。

grammar.key: Passive Voice (Present Simple) / 被动语态（一般现在时）
grammar.title: 被动语态（一般现在时）：从主动到被动的转换与拓展
grammar.titleEn: Passive Voice (Present Simple): From Active to Passive and Beyond
grammar.usage:
被动语态的核心功能是调整句子焦点：当说话人想强调动作的承受者、结果或状态，而不是执行者时，使用被动语态。一般现在时的被动语态结构为：主语（承受者）+ am/is/are + 过去分词（p.p.）。肯定句如：The course is designed for beginners. 否定句在 be 动词后加 not：The course is not designed for advanced learners. 一般疑问句将 be 动词提前：Is the course designed for beginners? 特殊疑问句则在疑问词后接 be 动词：Why is the course designed this way?

与主动语态对比：主动语态强调“谁做”，被动语态强调“什么被做”。例如主动句 Online courses provide a chance for students 的焦点是 online courses；而被动句 A chance is provided for students 的焦点是 a chance。当执行者不重要、未知或显而易见时，通常省略 by 短语。例如：English is spoken in many countries.（执行者“人们”显而易见，无需 by people）。

初中阶段主要要求掌握一般现在时、一般过去时和一般将来时的被动语态，侧重识别和基本转换。高中阶段则要求：1）在复杂语境中灵活选择主动或被动以优化表达；2）掌握含情态动词的被动结构（can/must/should be done）；3）理解被动语态与系表结构的区别（如 The door is closed 可表示“门被关上”的动作，也可表示“门是关着的”状态，需根据语境判断）；4）在书面语、科技文、新闻报道中恰当使用被动语态以增强客观性。

易错点一：不及物动词没有被动语态。happen, appear, disappear, exist, belong to 等不及物动词或短语不能用于被动结构。易错点二：be 动词的单复数必须与主语一致，而非与原主动句的宾语一致。易错点三：过去分词形式要准确，尤其是不规则动词。易错点四：不要混淆“被动语态”与“过去分词作表语”——前者强调动作，后者强调状态。
forms: 肯定句：主语 + am/is/are + 过去分词（+ by + 执行者）
否定句：主语 + am/is/are + not + 过去分词
一般疑问句：Am/Is/Are + 主语 + 过去分词？
特殊疑问句：疑问词 + am/is/are + 主语 + 过去分词？
含情态动词：主语 + can/must/should/may + be + 过去分词
主动转被动：主动句宾语 → 被动句主语；主动句谓语 → be + p.p.；主动句主语 → by + 宾语
notes: 不及物动词（happen, appear, exist, belong to 等）不能用于被动语态，高考语法填空和短文改错中常以此为陷阱。
be 动词的单复数取决于被动句的主语，而非原主动句的宾语。例如：A lot of money is spent on education. 主语 money 不可数，用 is。
书面语和科技文中，被动语态常省略 by 短语，以突出客观事实而非个人行为。高考写作中适当使用被动语态可提升语域。
注意区分“be + 过去分词”是表动作的被动语态还是表状态的系表结构。例如：The window is broken. 若强调“被打碎”的动作，是被动语态；若强调“是破的”这一状态，是系表结构。
含双宾语的动词（give, offer, send, teach 等）变为被动语态时有两种方式，高考常考其中一种：以直接宾语作主语时，间接宾语前需加介词 to 或 for。

grammar.title: 定语从句（which/that）——兼及 who/whom/whose 与非限制性定语从句
grammar.titleEn: Relative Clauses (which/that) and Related Relative Pronouns
grammar.usage:
定语从句的核心结构是“先行词 + 关系代词 + 从句”。先行词是被修饰的名词或名词短语，关系代词在从句中充当主语、宾语或表语等成分，同时把从句与先行词连接起来。which 用于指物，that 可指人或物，who/whom 指人，whose 表示所属关系。

肯定句结构为“先行词 + which/that + 从句谓语……”，例如：I like the film which/that was shown yesterday. 否定句在从句中正常使用否定形式，例如：She bought a phone which/that doesn’t work well. 疑问句通常是对主句提问，从句保持陈述语序，例如：Is this the app which/that you recommended?

which 与 that 在限制性定语从句中常可互换，但在非限制性定语从句中只能用 which，不能用 that。非限制性定语从句前有逗号，表示补充说明，去掉后主句意思仍然完整。例如：My new phone, which I bought last week, has a great camera.

初中阶段主要要求掌握限制性定语从句中 which/that/who 的基本用法，能识别先行词并判断关系代词在从句中作主语还是宾语。高中阶段则进一步要求掌握非限制性定语从句、关系代词的省略条件、介词+which 结构，以及定语从句与名词性从句、状语从句的区分。

易错点一：从句中重复指代先行词。例如“The video which I watched it was funny”中 it 多余，应去掉。易错点二：在非限制性定语从句中误用 that。易错点三：混淆 what 与 which/that，what 不能引导定语从句。易错点四：关系代词作宾语时在口语中可省略，但在书面语或正式文体中不宜随意省略，尤其在介词后不能省略。
forms: 先行词（物） + which/that + 从句谓语（which/that 作主语）
先行词（物） + which/that + 主语 + 谓语（which/that 作宾语，可省略）
先行词（人） + who/that + 从句谓语（who/that 作主语）
先行词（人） + whom/who/that + 主语 + 谓语（whom/who/that 作宾语）
先行词 + 介词 + which + 从句（正式书面语，介词前置）
先行词 + , + which + 从句（非限制性定语从句，补充说明）
notes: 高考书面表达中，非限制性定语从句用 which 而不用 that，逗号不能省略。
在“介词 + which”结构中，which 不能省略，也不能用 that 替换，例如 the platform on which people share videos。
关系代词在从句中作宾语时，口语中常省略，但正式书面语中保留更稳妥，尤其是高考语法填空需根据句子成分判断是否可省。
what 不是关系代词，不能引导定语从句；what 引导的是名词性从句，相当于 the thing that。
定语从句的谓语动词要与先行词在人称和数上保持一致，例如 a video which is short 与 videos which are short。

exercises.q: The man ______ you talked to just now is a famous writer.
exercises.explain: 先行词 man 是人，whom 在从句中作宾语。

exercises.q: Do you know the reason ______ he was late?
exercises.explain: 先行词 reason 在从句中作原因状语，用 why。

exercises.q: The woman ______ car was stolen called the police.
exercises.explain: whose 表示所属关系，修饰 car。

exercises.explain: that 已在从句中作宾语，不能再加 it。

exercises.explain: who 指人，在从句中作主语，句子正确。

exercises.explain: 用 where 引导定语从句，where 在从句中作地点状语。

exercises.q: The boy is my cousin. His bike was stolen. (用 whose 合并句子)

grammar.key: Concession Clauses (even though) / 让步状语从句（even though）
grammar.title: 让步状语从句：although / though / even though / while 及 even if 的辨析与拓展
grammar.titleEn: Concession Clauses: although, though, even though, while and even if
grammar.usage:
让步状语从句用于表达“虽然……但是……”或“尽管……仍然……”的逻辑关系。从句陈述一个与主句形成对比、出乎意料或构成阻碍的事实或情况，但主句所表达的内容依然成立。其核心结构为：Although/Though/Even though + 从句，主句；或主句 + although/though/even though + 从句。从句可以放在主句之前或之后，放在句首时通常用逗号与主句隔开。

肯定句、否定句和疑问句均可使用让步状语从句。肯定句中，主句和从句都表达肯定的事实；否定句中，从句或主句可以带否定词，如 Even though he didn't have much money, he bought the book. 疑问句中，让步从句可以修饰主句的疑问内容，如 Did she accept the job even though the salary was low? 需要注意的是，让步从句本身不因主句是疑问句而改变语序，从句内部仍用陈述语序。

在近义结构对比上，although、though 和 even though 都表示“虽然、尽管”，但语气和语域有所不同。although 较为正式，多用于书面语；though 较为口语化，也可作副词放在句末表示“不过、然而”；even though 语气最强，强调“即使存在某种事实，主句仍然成立”，常用来突出对比的强烈程度。while 表示“尽管”时，通常放在句首，引导一个与主句形成对照的从句，语气比 although 更弱，更侧重于“对比”而非“让步”。even if 则与 even though 不同：even though 引导的是已知事实，even if 引导的是假设情况，意为“即使（假设）……也……”。

初中阶段主要要求学生掌握 although 和 though 的基本用法，能够识别让步状语从句，并牢记不能与 but 连用这一核心规则。高中阶段则进一步要求区分 even though 与 even if 的语义差异，理解 while 作“尽管”讲的用法，并能在书面表达中根据语域选择 although（正式）或 though（口语化），同时学会用 even though 来增强论证力度。此外，高中阶段还要求学生能够在复杂句中准确判断让步从句与主句的逻辑关系，避免因从句位置变化而产生歧义。

易错点一：在英语中，although/though/even though 不能与 but 在同一句中连用，这是受中文“虽然……但是……”结构影响而产生的高频错误。易错点二：混淆 even though 和 even if。even though 后面接的是已经发生或客观存在的事实，even if 后面接的是假设或不确定的情况。易错点三：将 though 误用作连词以外的词性。though 作副词时放在句末，前面通常有逗号，表示“不过、然而”，与作连词时的位置和功能不同。易错点四：while 表示“尽管”时，只能放在句首引导从句，不能像 although 那样放在主句之后。
forms: Although/Though/Even though + 从句（陈述语序），主句
主句 + although/though/even though + 从句（陈述语序）
While + 从句（表对比/让步），主句
Even if + 从句（假设情况），主句（用 will/would/can/could 等）
主句 + though（作副词，位于句末，表“不过、然而”）
Although/Though/Even though + 从句 + 主句（注意：主句前不加 but）
notes: 高考书面表达中，although 比 though 更正式，适合议论文和说明文；though 更口语化，适合记叙文或书信等非正式文体。
even though 语气最强，常用于强调主句事实不受从句阻碍影响，适合在议论文中用来突出对比或论证力度。
even if 引导假设让步，从句中常用一般现在时表将来假设，主句用 will/would/can/could 等情态动词，注意与 even though 的事实让步区分。
while 作“尽管”讲时只能位于句首，且更侧重前后对比而非强烈让步，高考阅读中常出现此类用法，需根据上下文判断其含义。
though 作副词放在句末时，前面通常有逗号，表示“不过、然而”，这是高中阶段需要掌握的语域用法，不可与连词用法混淆。

examples.en: Even though it was raining, they went to the park.
examples.cn: 尽管当时在下雨，他们还是去了公园。

examples.en: Although he was tired, he kept working.
examples.cn: 虽然他很累，但他继续工作。

examples.en: She didn't get the job even though she had a lot of experience.
examples.cn: 尽管她经验丰富，她还是没有得到那份工作。

examples.en: While the plan sounds good, it may be hard to carry out.
examples.cn: 尽管这个计划听起来不错，但实施起来可能很困难。

examples.en: Even if you apologize, she may not forgive you.
examples.cn: 即使你道歉，她也可能不会原谅你。

examples.en: The evidence, though not conclusive, strongly suggests that the policy has had a positive effect.
examples.cn: 尽管证据并非决定性的，但它有力地表明该政策已经产生了积极效果。
